news.title: Mareykanka oo Soomaaliya ku daray 23-ka waddan ee heerka 4aad ee digniinta safarka
news.summary: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Mareykanka ayaa ogeysiis ay Isniintii 9 November soo saartay ku sheegtay in Soomaaliya ay ka mid tahay 23 waddan oo lagu daray heerka ugu sarreeya ee digniinta safarka, Heerka 4aad ee "Ha u safrin".
news.imageAlt: Xarunta Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Mareykanka, dhismaha Harry S. Truman ee Washington
news.imageCredit: U.S. Department of State / Wikimedia Commons
news.sourceRights: headline-and-link; © Caasimada Online, all rights reserved

news.title: Qarax ka dhacay warshad bir oo ku taal galbeedka Turkiga oo dilay ugu yaraan 16 qof
news.summary: Ugu yaraan 16 qof ayaa ku dhimatay 13 kalena way ku dhaawacmeen qarax Isniintii duhurkii ka dhacay warshadda birta ee Habaş ee degmada Aliağa, waqooyiga magaalada Izmir, sida ay sheegeen saraakiisha Turkiga; Madaxweyne Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ayaa ku dhawaaqay baaritaan.
news.imageAlt: Muuqaal guud oo laga qaaday degmada Aliağa ee gobolka Izmir, Turkiga
news.sourceRights: feed facts; © Al Jazeera, all rights reserved

news.title: Koonfur Afrika oo xirtay 9 ajnabi oo looga shakisan yahay inay u socdeen ciidamada Ruushka
news.summary: Booliska Koonfur Afrika ayaa sheegay in sagaal ajnabi ah oo da'doodu u dhaxayso 20 ilaa 26 sano lagu xiray garoonka OR Tambo ee Johannesburg iyo hoteel u dhow, iyagoo looga shakisan yahay inay u socdeen Ruushka si ay ugu dagaalamaan dagaalka Ukraine.
news.imageAlt: Munaaradda kontoroolka duulimaadyada ee garoonka caalamiga ah ee OR Tambo, Johannesburg
news.sourceRights: facts-only; © Al Jazeera / AP, all rights reserved

news.title: Holstein Kiel oo shaqada ka eriday tababaraha Tim Walter
news.summary: Kooxda Holstein Kiel ayaa shaqada ka eriday tababaraheeda Tim Walter oo 51 jir ah, kadib hal guul oo keliya 11 kulan oo ay kooxdu ku jirto kaalinta ugu hooseysa ee 2. Bundesliga, sida ay sheegtay bogga rasmiga ah ee Bundesliga.
news.imageAlt: Tababaraha kubadda cagta Tim Walter
news.sourceRights: facts-only; © DFL Deutsche Fußball Liga, all rights reserved

news.title: Garabka England Immanuel Feyi-Waboso oo ka maqnaan doona inta ka hartay Nations Championship
news.summary: Immanuel Feyi-Waboso, 23 jir, ayaa ka maqnaan doona inta ka hartay tartanka Nations Championship kadib dhaawac canqowga ah oo uu ka soo gaaray guushii England ay 45-22 kaga adkaatay Australia. England ayaa sidoo kale kulanka Japan ee Sabtida ku seegi doonta Seb Atkinson, Ollie Chessum iyo George Furbank.
news.imageAlt: Immanuel Feyi-Waboso oo u ciyaaraya England, Rome 2024

news.title: Kenya: Ruto oo Lydia Chelagat u magacaabay Guddoomiyaha Ilaalinta Xogta, shan hay'adood oo helay maamulayaal cusub
news.summary: Madaxweyne William Ruto ayaa Lydia Sitienei Chelagat u magacaabay xilka Guddoomiyaha Ilaalinta Xogta (Data Commissioner), magaceedana u gudbiyay Golaha Qaranka si loo ansixiyo. Isla markaana shan hay'adood oo dowladeed, oo ay ku jiraan Hay'adda Hantida Dowladda la Iibinayo iyo Hay'adda La-dagaallanka Daroogada Ciyaaraha (ADAK), ayaa ku dhawaaqay maamulayaal cusub.
news.imageAlt: William Ruto oo ka hadlaya golaha WTO 2014

news.title: Wargeyska baaritaannada ee Ruushka Novaya Gazeta oo xirmay kadib cadaadis dowladeed
news.summary: Wargeyska Novaya Gazeta, oo ka mid ahaa warbaahinta yar ee Ruushka ku hartay ee dhaleeceysa dagaalka Ukraine, ayaa Isniintii qabtay kulankiisii ugu dambeeyay ee tifaftirka oo xiray xafiiskiisa. Wargeyska ayaa horay u sheegay in lagu qasbay xiritaanka kadib markii Moscow ay ku tilmaantay "wakiil shisheeye".
news.imageAlt: Xafiiska wargeyska Novaya Gazeta ee Moscow

news.title: Xildhibaan Jamhuuri ah Thomas Massie oo ku qasbaya codbixin lagu xil ka qaadayo Wasiirka Difaaca Hegseth
news.summary: Xildhibaanka Jamhuuriga Thomas Massie ayaa sheegay inuu toddobaadkan Aqalka Wakiillada ku qasbi doono codbixin lagu xil ka qaadayo Wasiirka Difaaca Pete Hegseth, isagoo ku eedeeyay inuu jebiyay dastuurka maadaama uu dagaal ka waday Iran in ka badan 90 maalmood oggolaansho Congress la'aan. Dadaalkan ayaa la filayaa inuu fashilmo.
news.imageAlt: Sawirka rasmiga ah ee xildhibaan Thomas Massie, 2022
news.imageCredit: Clerk of the House of Representatives / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Meta oo adduunka oo dhan ka bilaabaysa hubin da'da dhalinyarada ah oo lagu sameeyo AI
news.summary: Shirkadda Meta ayaa sheegtay in bishan ay Instagram ka bilaabayso tiknoolajiyad AI ah oo qiyaasta da'da, si ay u hesho dhalinyarada isticmaala taariikh dhalasho oo qof weyn ah oo ay ugu wareejiso Teen Accounts, kadibna ay ku fidinayso Facebook iyo Threads.
news.imageAlt: Albaabka xarunta Meta ee Menlo Park, California

news.title: Uganda: Maalgelin la'aan ayaa dib u dhigaysa ka guurista isticmaalka meerkuriga ee macdan qodista dahabka
news.summary: Daneeyayaal ku shiray Kampala shirka sannadlaha ah ee planetGOLD Uganda ayaa sheegay in maalgelin la'aan ay ka hor istaagayso macdan qodayaasha yaryar inay iibsadaan qalab ammaan ah oo aan meerkuri isticmaalin.
news.imageAlt: Macdan qode dahab oo yar oo ka yimid bariga Uganda oo ku nasanaya gaari-gacan

news.title: Mareykanka oo Rwanda u celiyay Jean Léonard Teganya oo lagu eedeeyay xasuuqii 1994
news.summary: Hay'adda Xeer-ilaalinta Qaranka Rwanda ayaa sheegtay in 9 November 2026 ay gacanta ku dhigtay Jean Léonard Teganya oo Mareykanka laga soo masaafuriyay, kaasoo looga baahan yahay eedeymo la xiriira xasuuqii 1994 iyo dambiyo ka dhan ah aadanaha oo lagu sheegay inay ka dhaceen Butare; diyaaraddii siday ayaa ku degtay Garoonka Caalamiga ah ee Kigali qiyaastii 6-dii fiidnimo.
news.imageAlt: Dhismaha Garoonka Caalamiga ah ee Kigali, Rwanda

news.title: Uganda oo maalgashadayaal shisheeye u raadinaysa ballaarinta wax-soo-saarka iyo warshadaynta bunka
news.summary: Dowladda Uganda ayaa sheegtay inay higsanayso 20 milyan oo kiish oo bun ah sannadkii marka la gaaro 2030, ayna maalgashadayaal shisheeye ka raadinayso waraabka, beeraha ganacsiga iyo warshadaynta gudaha; bunku wuxuu dalka u keenaa qiyaastii 24% dakhliga lacagta qalaad.
news.imageAlt: Bun la gurtay oo laga soo goostay beer ku taal Uganda

news.title: Museveni oo xilalkooda ku sii hayay Yunus Kakande iyo 15 xoghaye oo joogto ah
news.summary: Madaxweyne Yoweri Museveni ayaa Hajji Yunus Kakande ku sii hayay xilka Xoghayaha Joogtada ah ee Xafiiska Madaxweynaha, isagoo ka mid ah 16 xoghaye oo joogto ah oo xilalkooda sii haya magacaabistii ugu dambeysay; Wasiirka Madaxtooyada Milly Babalanda ayaa sheegtay in go'aankaasi muujinayo kalsoonida Madaxweynaha.
news.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Uganda Yoweri Museveni
news.lengthNote: Nile Post kaliya ayaa laga helay xogta; magacyada 15-ka xoghaye ee kale iyo taariikhda magacaabista lama shaacin.

news.title: Carlos Vicens oo si rasmi ah loogu magacaabay tababaraha Olympique Lyonnais
news.summary: Tababaraha reer Spain Carlos Vicens oo 43 jir ah ayaa heshiis hal sano iyo bar ah la saxiixday Olympique Lyonnais, wuxuuna bedelayaa Paulo Fonseca oo dhowaan u dhaqaaqay Sporting.
news.imageAlt: Garoonka Groupama Stadium ee kooxda Olympique Lyonnais, magaalada Lyon

news.title: Sassuolo oo xilka ka qaaday tababare Alberto Aquilani wax ka yar 5 bilood kadib
news.summary: Kooxda Sassuolo ee Serie A ayaa 9 November xilka ka qaaday Alberto Aquilani oo la magacaabay bishii June, kadib markii ay guuldarraystay 6 ka mid ah 7-dii kulan ee u dambeeyay, ayna ku dhowdahay goobta hoos u dhaca; waa tababarihii 6-aad ee Talyaaniga laga eryo 11 wareeg gudahood.
news.imageAlt: Alberto Aquilani oo xiran funaanadda Fiorentina sannadkii 2012

news.title: Faransiiska oo Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran ku eedeeyay weerarkii internetka ee qaboojiyeyaasha suuqyada
news.summary: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Faransiiska Jean-Noël Barrot ayaa Isniintii ku eedeeyay Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ee Iran weerarkii internetka ee bishii hore gaaray qaboojiyeyaasha suuqyada, kaas oo sababay in cuntada cusub ay ku xumaato ilaa 700 dukaan, isagoo ku tilmaamay weerar baaxaddiisa iyo gardarradiisa aan horay loo arag; wuxuu sheegay in Faransiisku uu doonayo cunaqabateyn heer Yurub ah.
news.imageAlt: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Faransiiska Jean-Noël Barrot oo shir jaraa'id ku qabtay Paris, January 2025
news.imageCredit: Official State Department photo by Chuck Kennedy / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Raúl, halyeygii Real Madrid, oo loo magacaabay tababaraha Real Oviedo
news.summary: Weeraryahankii hore ee Real Madrid Raúl González oo 49 jir ah ayaa loo magacaabay tababaraha kooxda Real Oviedo ee ka ciyaarta heerka 2-aad ee Spain, isagoo saxiixay heshiis ilaa June 2028; wuxuu bedelay Julián Calero oo Isniintii la eryay iyadoo kooxdu ay kaalinta 9-aad ku jirto.
news.imageAlt: Raúl González, halyeygii Real Madrid (sawir May 2019)

news.title: Kenya: Kindiki oo sheegay in aan gobol ka liito gobol kale, Taita Taveta-na u ballanqaaday horumar
news.summary: Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Kenya Kithure Kindiki ayaa sheegay in dowladdu ay si siman u qaybin doonto kheyraadka qaranka iyadoo aan loo eegin taageerada siyaasadeed ee gobollada, isagoo ballanqaaday maalgelin horumarineed oo dheeraad ah oo loogu talagalay degmada Taita Taveta oo muddo dheer la dayacay; wuxuu sheegay in mabda'a 'Usawa ni Sawa' uu salka u yahay ajandaha dib-u-doorashada Madaxweyne William Ruto.
news.imageAlt: Kithure Kindiki oo xafiiskiisa ku jira (sawir 2023)

news.title: Kenya: Duale iyo WHO oo dib u eegay jawaabta Ebola kadib 3 toddobaad oo aan kiis cusub lahayn
news.summary: Wasiirka Caafimaadka Kenya Aden Duale ayaa kulan la yeeshay ergo ka socota Ururka Caafimaadka Adduunka (WHO) oo uu hoggaaminayo Agaasimaha Gobolka Afrika, si ay dib ugu eegaan jawaabta Kenya ee cudurka Ebola nooca Bundibugyo ee dibadda ka yimid, iyadoo dalku diiwaangeliyay 3 toddobaad oo xiriir ah oo aan kiis cusub oo la xaqiijiyay lahayn.
news.imageAlt: Aden Duale, oo hadda ah Wasiirka Caafimaadka Kenya (sawir September 2023)
news.imageCredit: U.S. Secretary of Defense / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Pau Cubarsí oo ku guuleystay abaalmarinta Golden Boy 2026
news.summary: Daafaca Barcelona Pau Cubarsí oo 19 jir ah ayaa loo doortay Golden Boy 2026, abaalmarinta ciyaaryahanka ugu fiican Yurub ee ka yar 21 sano oo uu bixiyo wargeyska Talyaaniga ee Tuttosport, isagoo ka horreeyay Yan Diomande iyo Warren Zaire-Emery; waa ciyaaryahankii 5-aad ee Barcelona ee ku guuleysta kadib Messi, Pedri, Gavi iyo Lamine Yamal.
news.imageAlt: Pau Cubarsí oo ka ciyaaraya ciyaartii Argentina iyo Spain ee finalka Koobka Adduunka 2026

news.title: Trump oo shaki geliyay natiijada doorashada xilliga dhexe, kadib markii uu horay u sheegay inuu aqbalayo
news.summary: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa Isniintii bartiisa Truth Social ku weydiiyay haddii uu jiro qof rumeysan in doorashadan ay daacad ahayd, isagoo aan caddeyn keenin, kadib markii Dimuqraadiyiintu ay dib ula wareegeen labada aqal ee Kongareeska; habeenkii doorashada wuxuu u sheegay New York Times inuu gabi ahaanba diyaar u yahay inuu aqbalo natiijada.
news.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Donald Trump oo ku sugan Xafiiska Oval-ka ee Aqalka Cad (sawir March 2025)

news.title: Hay'adda SoDMA oo qoysaska barakacayaasha ah ee Beledweyne u qaybisay agab gargaar
news.summary: Hay'adda Maareynta Musiibooyinka Soomaaliya (SoDMA) ayaa Isniintii Beledweyne u qaybisay agab aan cunto ahayn, oo ay ku jiraan bacaha roobka iyo qalab guri, kuwaas oo loogu talagalay qoysaska barakacayaasha iyo kuwa nugul.
news.imageAlt: Muuqaal guud oo magaalada Beledweyne
news.sourceRights: facts-only; © Radio Muqdisho, all rights reserved
news.lengthNote: Radio Muqdisho oo ah isha kaliya ayaa bixisay xog kooban: ma sheegin tirada qoysaska, qiimaha gargaarka ama hadal toos ah. Wax kale lama helin.

news.title: Tanzania: Sahan macdan oo cusub oo lagu sameynayo diyaaradaha drone-ka iyo diyaarado hooseeya
news.summary: Hay'adda Sahanka Juqraafiga ee Tanzania (GST) ayaa si rasmi ah u bilowday barnaamij sahan macdan oo casri ah oo adeegsanaya drone-yo gaar ah iyo diyaarado si hoose u duula, iyadoo Wasiirka Macdanta Anthony Mavunde uu ku dhawaaqay Mirerani, halkaas oo lagu ogaanayo baaxadda suunka dhagaxa tanzanite-ka.
news.imageAlt: Dhagax tanzanite ah oo aan la farsameyn oo laga soo saaray Mirerani, Tanzania

news.title: Kenya: Murkomen oo saaxiibada caalamka u ballanqaaday doorasho nabadeed 2027
news.summary: Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha Kenya Kipchumba Murkomen ayaa Isniintii kulan uu Nairobi kula yeeshay madaxda ergada Kooxda Deeq-bixiyeyaasha Qaxootiga iyo saaxiibo kale ku sheegay in Kenya ay si buuxda ugu diyaargaroobayso doorasho nabadeed oo 2027 dhacda, isla markaana Adeegga Booliska Qaranka uu xoojinayo diyaargarowgiisa wejiyada doorashada oo dhan.
news.imageAlt: Kipchumba Murkomen, oo hadda ah Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha Kenya (sawir 2013)

news.title: Kenya: Mudavadi oo dalbaday in dallacsiinta shaqaalaha dowladda lagu xiro waxqabadka
news.summary: Ra'iisul Wasaare Xoghayaha Golaha Wasiirrada Kenya Musalia Mudavadi ayaa ku baaqay sharci isku xira waxqabadka iyo wax-soo-saarka shaqaalaha dowladda iyo dallacsiintooda, isagoo sheegay in heshiisyada waxqabadka aysan noqon karin caado keliya ee ay noqdaan waajib sharci.
news.imageAlt: Ra'iisul Wasaare Xoghayaha Golaha Wasiirrada Kenya Musalia Mudavadi
news.imageCredit: U.S. Department of State / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Finnair: Xog ka dhac ka dhacay nidaamka Amadeus oo saameyn kara 116,000 ballan duulimaad
news.summary: Shirkadda diyaaradaha Finland ee Finnair ayaa sheegtay in xog ka dhac ka dhacay nidaamka caalamiga ah ee ballansashada Amadeus uu saameyn karo ilaa 116,000 ballan duulimaad oo macaamiisheeda ah.
news.imageAlt: Diyaarad Airbus A350 ah oo ay leedahay shirkadda Finnair
news.lengthNote: Warbixinta asalka ah waa gaaban; tafaasiisha xogta la dhacay si buuxda looma shaacin.

news.title: Ingiriiska: Russell Brand oo lagu xukumay 10 sano iyo 6 bilood oo xabsi ah
news.summary: Maxkamadda Southwark Crown Court ee London ayaa Isniintii jilaaga iyo majaajiliistaha Ingiriiska Russell Brand ku xukuntay 10 sano iyo 6 bilood oo xabsi ah, kadib markii toddobaadkii hore lagu helay dembiyo kufsi iyo faraxumeyn galmo oo loo geystay 4 haween intii u dhaxeysay 2004 iyo 2009. Brand wuxuu sheegay inuu dembi la'aan yahay.
news.imageAlt: Dhismaha maxkamadda Southwark Crown Court ee London

news.title: Wasiir Fiqi iyo safiirka Shiinaha oo ka wada hadlay AUSSOM iyo kala-guurka amniga
news.summary: Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa Muqdisho ku qaabilay safiirka Shiinaha Wang Yu, waxayna ka wada hadleen iskaashiga difaaca, dagaalka Al-Shabaab iyo mustaqbalka howlgalka AUSSOM.
news.imageAlt: Axmed Macallin Fiqi oo ku sugan Cadaado, November 2016
news.sourceRights: facts-only; © Hiiraan Online, all rights reserved

news.title: Tanzania: Nin looga shakiyay inuu hoggaamiyo shabakad daroogo oo lagu qabtay Kenya
news.summary: Hay'adda La-dagaallanka Daroogada ee Tanzania (DCEA) ayaa sheegtay in hawlgal wadajir ah oo ay la sameysay hay'adaha Kenya lagu qabtay Saleh Khamis Baseleman oo loo yaqaan Mbwiga, oo ah muwaadin Tanzaniyaan ah oo ku nool Mombasa, kana mid ah 7 qof oo la xiray. Waxaa lagu eedeeyay inuu daroogo ka keeni jiray Afgaanistaan, badda uga soo gudbin jiray xeebta Mombasa, kana qaybin jiray dalal ay Tanzania ka mid tahay.
news.imageAlt: Dekedda Mombasa ee xeebta Kenya

news.title: Google oo soo bandhigtay laba nooc oo cusub oo chip-ka AI ah si ay ula tartanto Nvidia
news.summary: Shirkadda Google, oo ka tirsan kooxda Alphabet, ayaa soo bandhigtay laba nooc oo cusub oo ah chip-yada sirdoonka macmalka ah ee loo yaqaan TPU (tensor processing units), iyadoo ballaarinaysa tartankeeda ay kula jirto Nvidia.
news.imageAlt: Chip-ka Tensor Processing Unit 3.0 ee Google

news.title: Kenya: Sakaja oo Senate-ka u sharxay hoos u dhaca Sh43.73 bilyan ee deymaha Nairobi
news.summary: Guddoomiyaha gobolka Nairobi Johnson Sakaja ayaa Guddiga Xisaabaadka Dowladaha Hoose ee Senate-ka u sheegay in deymaha aan la bixin ee magaalada laga dhimay Sh118.79 bilyan ilaa Sh75.07 bilyan, isagoo sheegay in hoos u dhaca Sh43.73 bilyan aan lagu gaarin lacag-bixin keliya ee ay ku jiraan qiimeyn sharci, go'aanno maxkamadeed iyo hubinta sheegashooyin lagu muransan yahay.
news.imageAlt: Guddoomiyaha gobolka Nairobi Johnson Sakaja, 2024

news.title: Koonfur Suudaan: Haweenka Bariga Equatoria oo dalbaday taageero lagu xoojiyo nabadda
news.summary: Kooxaha haweenka ee gobolka Bariga Equatoria, oo ay ku jiraan dhaqdhaqaaqa Mothers' Voice for Peace iyo ururo ka hawlgala degmooyinka Budi, Kapoeta East, Torit iyo Ikotos, ayaa dowladda iyo deeq-bixiyeyaasha ka dalbaday taageero dheeraad ah oo lagu wajaho amni darrada laguna xoojiyo nabadda.
news.imageAlt: Haweeney Koonfur Suudaaniyad ah oo ku sugan Torit, Bariga Equatoria

news.title: Koonfur Suudaan: Galbeedka Equatoria oo tababar u furtay saraakiisha doorashada
news.summary: Guddoomiyaha ku-meelgaarka ah ee gobolka Galbeedka Equatoria, Badagbu Daniel Rimbasa, ayaa magaalada Yambio ka furay tababar 2 maalmood ah oo loogu talagalay saraakiisha soo celinta doorashada iyo kaaliyayaashooda, si loogu diyaargaroobo doorashooyinka soo socda.
news.imageAlt: Dhalinyaro ku sugan magaalada Yambio, Galbeedka Equatoria

news.title: Danjiraha Türkiye Ferhat Alkan oo kulan la qaatay Madaxweynihii hore Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo
news.summary: Danjiraha Türkiye u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Ferhat Alkan, ayaa kulan isbarasho ah la yeeshay Madaxweynihii 9-aad ee Soomaaliya, Maxamed Cabdullaahi Maxamed Farmaajo. Labada dhinac waxay ka wada hadleen xaaladda Soomaaliya, xiriirka Türkiye iyo Soomaaliya iyo arrimaha gobolka iyo caalamka, sida lagu sheegay war ka soo baxay Safaaradda Türkiye.
news.imageAlt: Danjiraha Türkiye Ferhat Alkan (bidix) iyo Madaxweynihii hore ee Soomaaliya Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo (midig) oo is garab taagan, calanka Soomaaliya oo gadaashooda ka muuqda

news.title: FIFPro: 5 ciyaartoy Isbaanish ah oo ku jira kooxda ugu fiican adduunka ee haweenka 2026
news.summary: Ururka ciyaartoyda xirfadlayaasha ah ee FIFPro ayaa shaaciyay FIFPro World 11 ee haweenka 2026, oo ay codeeyeen 6511 ciyaartoy xirfadlayaal ah oo ka kala socda 64 waddan; waxaa ku jira Irene Paredes, Mapi León, Aitana Bonmatí, Alexia Putellas iyo Claudia Pina.
news.imageAlt: Ciyaaryahanadda Aitana Bonmatí oo garoonka ku jirta

news.title: Faransiiska: Lecornu oo hore u soo dhigay kororka 1.6% ee mushaharka ugu yar
news.summary: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Faransiiska Sébastien Lecornu ayaa Isniintii ku dhawaaqay in kororka 1.6% ee mushaharka ugu yar oo loo qorsheeyay Janaayo la hormarinayo oo la dhaqangelinayo Diseembar, kadib wadahadallo uu la yeeshay ururada shaqaalaha iyo ganacsatada, iyadoo dalku wajahayo mudaaharaadyo ka dhan ah qaalinnimada nolosha; ururadu waxay sheegeen in kororku aanu gaarin dalabaadkooda.
news.imageAlt: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Faransiiska Sébastien Lecornu

news.title: NFL: Jacksonville Jaguars oo Atlanta Falcons kala soo wareegay Jessie Bates III
news.summary: Kooxda Jacksonville Jaguars ayaa ka hor waqtiga kama dambaysta ah ee iibka NFL ee Talaadada heshiis la gaartay Atlanta Falcons si ay u hesho difaaca All-Pro-ga ah Jessie Bates III, iyadoo Falcons ay helayaan doorashada wareegga 2 ee 2027 iyo wareegga 5 ee 2028, iyadoo la soo xiganayo ESPN.
news.imageAlt: Ciyaaryahanka NFL Jessie Bates III

news.title: Kenya: Victor Wanyama oo kabtan u noqonaya halyeeyada Harambee Stars ee wajahaya Arsenal
news.summary: Kabtankii hore ee Harambee Stars Victor Wanyama ayaa hoggaamin doona halyeeyada xulka Kenya ee la ciyaaraya halyeeyada Arsenal tartanka Legends Cup oo Jimcaha ka dhacaya garoonka Nyayo, isagoo ay la socdaan MacDonald Mariga iyo Dennis Oliech.
news.imageAlt: Ciyaaryahanka reer Kenya Victor Wanyama

news.title: Kremlin-ka oo diiday in Yurub ka qayb gasho wadahadallada Abu Dhabi
news.summary: Afhayeenka Kremlin-ka Dmitry Peskov ayaa Isniintii sheegay in kulanka nabadda ee toddobaadkan lagu qaban doono Abu Dhabi, oo ay ka qayb gelayaan wakiillo Ukraine iyo Mareykan ah, aanay ka qayb geli doonin saraakiil Midowga Yurub, isagoo xusay in Mareykanka iyo Ukraine ay leeyihiin kanaallo ay kula xiriiraan reer Yurub.
news.imageAlt: Afhayeenka Kremlin-ka Dmitry Peskov
news.imageCredit: The Presidential Press and Information Office / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Koonfur Suudaan: Booliska Yei oo xiray nin looga shakisan yahay dilka arday dugsi sare
news.summary: Booliska degmada Yei River ayaa xiray nin looga shakisan yahay dilka Henry Dengero, oo ahaa arday fasalka Senior 2 ee dugsiga Yei Day Secondary School, kaas oo la sheegay in burcad ay toogteen kadibna mootadiisa kala dhaceen habeennimadii Jimcaha, sida uu sheegay kormeeraha booliska degmada Yoasa Lujang Kamba.
news.imageAlt: Waddo ku taal bartamaha ganacsiga ee Yei, Koonfur Suudaan

news.title: Uganda: Wasiir Justine Lumumba oo ku baaqday in tiknoolajiyadda la gaarsiiyo miyiga
news.summary: Wasiirka ICT-ga iyo Hanuuninta Qaranka ee Uganda, Justine Lumumba, ayaa Sabtidii booqatay mashruuca Tuulada Casriga ah ee Buhadyo ee degmada Butaleja, waxayna ku baaqday in bulshooyinka miyiga ay si ballaaran u qaataan tiknoolajiyadda si loo yareeyo farqiga dijitaalka.
news.imageAlt: Wasiir Justine Kasule Lumumba
news.lengthNote: Nile Post ma bixin miisaaniyad, jadwal ama tirada ka faa'iideystayaasha; xogta booqashada way kooban tahay.

news.title: Kenya: Ronald Karauri oo ku biiray UDA si uu ula tartamo Sakaja xilka guddoomiyaha Nairobi
news.summary: Xildhibaanka Kasarani Ronald Karauri ayaa si rasmi ah ugu biiray xisbiga talada haya ee UDA si uu ugu tartamo xilka guddoomiyaha gobolka Nairobi doorashada 2027. Arrintan ayaa timid maalmo kadib markii Guddoomiye Johnson Sakaja uu UDA uga wareegay xisbiga ODM.
news.imageAlt: Ronald Karauri

news.title: Trump oo sheegay in nacaybka Israa'iil uu ka mid ahaa sababaha Jamhuuriyiinta looga adkaaday
news.summary: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa wareysi uu siiyay barnaamijka "60 Minutes" ee CBS ku sheegay in dagaalka Iran, kororka qiimaha shidaalka iyo nacayb loo qabo Israa'iil ay ka mid ahaayeen sababaha Jamhuuriyiintu uga guuldarreysteen doorashooyinka xilliga dhexe.
news.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Donald Trump oo wareysi la yeelanaya barnaamijka 60 Minutes (2025)

news.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo ka qaybgalaya shirka cimilada COP31 ee Antalya
news.summary: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa ka qaybgalaya shirka 31-aad ee Qaramada Midoobay ee isbeddelka cimilada (COP31) oo Isniintii ka furmay magaalada Antalya ee Turkiga.
news.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo ka hadlaya kulan London, May 2013
news.sourceRights: facts-only; © Hiiraan Online, all rights reserved

news.title: Alisson oo sheegay in uu doonayo in uu sii joogo Liverpool
news.summary: Goolhayaha Liverpool Alisson, oo heshiiskiisu dhamaanayo dhammaadka xilli ciyaareedkan, ayaa sheegay in rabitaankiisu yahay in uu sii joogo Anfield, kadib guushii 3-1 ee Axaddii ay ka gaareen Crystal Palace.
news.imageAlt: Goolhaye Alisson oo ciyaar saaxiibtinimo u ciyaaraya Brazil sannadkii 2018

news.title: Uganda: Bangiga Dhexe oo heerka dulsaarka ku sii hayay 12%
news.summary: Bangiga Dhexe ee Uganda ayaa heerka dulsaarka ee CBR ku sii hayay 12%, isagoo ka digay in qiimaha tamarta, hoos u dhaca shilinka iyo cimilada xun ay sare u qaadi karaan sicir bararka, sida uu sheegay Guddoomiyaha bangiga Michael Atingi-Ego. Bangiga ayaa sidoo kale ballaariyay xadka CBR oo laga dhigay 3 dhibcood oo boqolley ah.
news.imageAlt: Xarunta Bangiga Dhexe ee Uganda ee Kampala

news.title: Kenya: Ruto oo ku jees jeesay hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka ee sheeganaya malaayiin cod
news.summary: Madaxweyne William Ruto ayaa su'aal geliyay sheegashada Rigathi Gachagua, Kalonzo Musyoka iyo Fred Matiang'i ee ah in ay haystaan malaayiin cod, kadib kulan ay toddobaadkan ku yeesheen Nairobi oo ku saabsanaa doorashada 2027. Ruto ayaa hadalkan ka sheegay socdaal uu ku marayay gobolka Gusii.
news.imageAlt: Madaxweyne William Ruto oo khudbad u jeedinaya dadweynaha gobolka Meru

news.title: Giriigga: Ugu yaraan 21 muhaajiriin ah oo ku dhintay isku day ay ku doonayeen gaarista Crete
news.summary: Ilaalada xeebaha Giriigga ayaa sheegtay in ugu yaraan 21 qof ay ku dhinteen isku day ay ku doonayeen in ay gaaraan jasiiradda Crete, halka in ka badan 100 qof lagu badbaadiyay hawlgallo dhowr ah oo koonfurta jasiiradda ka dhacay.
news.imageAlt: Xarunta Ilaalada Xeebaha Giriigga ee dekedda Heraklion, jasiiradda Crete

news.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo Jowhar ka furay xarumo cusub oo Hirshabeelle
news.summary: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Isniintii magaalada Jowhar ka furay xarumaha cusub ee Golaha Wakiillada Hirshabeelle iyo Wasaaradda Amniga ee maamulkaas.
news.imageAlt: Muuqaal hawada laga qaaday oo magaalada Jowhar iyo beeraha ku xeeran
news.sourceRights: facts-only; © Goobjoog Media Group, all rights reserved

news.title: Xasan Cali Khayre oo laba sarkaal ku eedeeyay dil iyo dhulboob ka dhacay xaafadda Raadeerka ee Deyniile
news.summary: Ra'iisul wasaarihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Xasan Cali Khayre, ayaa bartiisa Facebook ku cambaareeyay waxa uu ugu yeeray xasuuq, dhulboob iyo barakicin ka socda xaafadda Raadeerka ee degmada Deyniile, wuxuuna eedda dusha uga tuuray laba sarkaal oo uu magacaabay. Saraakiisha iyo dowladda midkoodna weli kama jawaabin eedeymahan.
news.imageAlt: Sawir la isku dhafay oo baraha bulshada lagu faafiyay, kaas oo muujinaya laba sarkaal oo booliis ah oo la sheegay inay yihiin saraakiisha uu Xasan Cali Khayre magacaabay

news.title: Cricket: England oo Brydon Carse u furtay dib u soo laabasho, Shoaib Bashir-na ka reebtay
news.summary: England ayaa ciyaartoyga Brydon Carse ku dartay kooxda Lions, taasoo u furaysa inuu ku soo laabto Test-ka safarka Koonfur Afrika, halka 15-ka ciyaartoy ee taxanaha 3-da Test ee ka bilaabanaya Johannesburg 17-ka Diseembar uu Liam Patterson-White ku beddelay Shoaib Bashir.
news.imageAlt: Ciyaartoyga cricket-ka England Brydon Carse

news.title: Kenya: Murkomen oo ugu baaqay Sifuna inuu taageero Ruto, kuna ballanqaaday hoggaanka 2032
news.summary: Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha Kenya, Kipchumba Murkomen, ayaa ugu baaqay Senatarka Nairobi Edwin Sifuna inuu ka tanaasulo hamigiisa madaxweyne ee doorashada 2027 oo uu garab istaago Madaxweyne William Ruto, isagoo sheegay in bulshada Luhya ay sidaas ku heli karto hoggaanka dalka sannadka 2032.
news.imageAlt: Senatarka Nairobi Edwin Sifuna, 2024

news.title: Pierre Kalulu oo dhaawac darteed seegi doona kulamada Faransiiska ee Nations League
news.summary: Baaritaanno lagu sameeyay kadib kulankii Juventus iyo Fiorentina ayaa muujiyay in daafaca Pierre Kalulu uu dhaawac muruq ah ka gaaray lugta bidix, sidaas darteed ma ka qayb gali doono kulamada Faransiiska ee Talyaaniga iyo Turkiga.
news.imageAlt: Daafaca Pierre Kalulu, 2022

news.title: Koonfur Suudaan: Jen. Joseph Lagu waxaa lagu aasi doonaa xabaalaha Dr John Garang ee Juba
news.summary: Guddiga qabanqaabada aaska qaran ee Jeneraal Joseph Lagu Yanga, hoggaamiyihii dhaqdhaqaaqa Anyanya One, ayaa u sheegay Eye Radio in lagu aasi doono gudaha xabaalaha Dr John Garang ee magaalada Juba, kadib markii Madaxweyne Salva Kiir go'aamiyay in loo sameeyo aas qaran.
news.imageAlt: Jeneraal Joseph Lagu oo yimid goobta xabaalaha Dr John Garang ee Juba, 9 Luulyo 2011
news.imageCredit: U.S. Department of State / Wikimedia Commons
news.lengthNote: Eye Radio waxay bixisay xog kooban: taariikhda aaska lama shaacin, mana jiraan hadallo toos ah.

news.title: Halyeeyga judo-da Teddy Riner oo u tartamaya madaxweynaha Faransiiska 2027
news.summary: Teddy Riner, oo 5 jeer ku guuleystay bilad dahab ah oo Olombikada ah, ayaa Isniintii ku dhawaaqay inuu u tartami doono doorashada madaxweynaha Faransiiska ee sannadka 2027.
news.imageAlt: Teddy Riner, halyeeyga judo-da Faransiiska

news.title: Trump: "Waan ku guuleysanay Iran", iyadoo ciidamada Mareykanku weerar ku qaadeen jasiiradda Qeshm
news.summary: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa Axaddii sheegay in Mareykanku "ku guuleystay" dagaalka Iran, dagaal cusubna uusan u badneyn haddii Tehran heshiis la gasho, iyadoo ciidamada Mareykanku duqeeyeen jasiiradda Qeshm ee Marinka Hormuz.
news.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Donald Trump oo ku sugan Xafiiska Oval

news.title: Uganda: Injineerka sare ee CAA iyo 10 kale oo maxkamad la keenay kadib burburinta garoonka Entebbe
news.summary: 11 sarkaal oo ka tirsan Hay'adda Duulista Rayidka ee Uganda, oo uu ku jiro injineerka sare Herbert Ngobi, ayaa Isniintii la horkeenay Maxkamadda Sare ee Entebbe iyagoo lagu eedeeyay dayacaad shaqo oo la xiriirta burburinta qalabka garoonka diyaaradaha oo qiimihiisu yahay Shs3.7 bilyan.
news.imageAlt: Garoonka diyaaradaha caalamiga ah ee Entebbe, Uganda

news.title: Golf: Blades Brown oo 19 jir ah noqday guuleystaha ugu da'da yar PGA Tour muddo 95 sano ah
news.summary: Ciyaaryahanka golf-ka Mareykanka Blades Brown oo 19 jir ah ayaa ku guuleystay tartanka World Wide Technology Championship ee Mexico, kadib markii uu Ben James kaga adkaaday godka labaad ee kala-saarka, isagoo noqday guuleystaha ugu da'da yar PGA Tour muddo 95 sano ah.
news.imageAlt: Ciyaaryahanka golf-ka Mareykanka Blades Brown

news.title: Iran: Kormeerayaasha IAEA ayaa dhowaan booqday xarunta nukliyeerka ee Bushehr
news.summary: Afhayeenka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Iran Esmaeil Baghaei ayaa sheegay in kormeerayaasha Hay'adda Tamarta Nukliyeerka Adduunka (IAEA) ay dhowaan booqdeen warshadda korontada nukliyeerka ee Bushehr, isagoo ku tilmaamay caddayn in iskaashiga hay'addu uu socdo.
news.imageAlt: Warshadda korontada nukliyeerka ee Bushehr, Iran

news.title: Guterres: Adduunku wuxuu galay 'xilli cimilo xad-dhaaf ah'
news.summary: Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay Antonio Guterres ayaa Isniinta ugu baaqay hoggaamiyeyaasha ku shiraya COP31 ee Antalya inay dardargeliyaan dhimista qiiqa iyo ka guurista shidaalka, isagoo sheegay in adduunku galay 'xilli cusub oo cimilo xad-dhaaf ah'.
news.imageAlt: Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay Antonio Guterres
news.imageCredit: U.S. Department of State from United States / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Tanzania iyo WTTC oo London ka wada hadlay soo jiidashada maalgashi dalxiis
news.summary: Wasiirka Kheyraadka Dabiiciga iyo Dalxiiska Tanzania Dr Ashatu Kijaji ayaa London kula kulmay guddoomiyaha Golaha Safarka iyo Dalxiiska Adduunka (WTTC) Manfredi Lefebvre, waxayna ka wada hadleen maalgashiga dalxiiska iyo kordhinta booqdayaasha caalamiga ah, sida uu werisay wargeyska dowladda ee Daily News.
news.imageAlt: Manfredi Lefebvre, guddoomiyaha WTTC (sawir 2015)
news.imageCredit: World Travel & Tourism Council / Wikimedia Commons
news.lengthNote: Warbixinta Daily News ma sheegin heshiis ama tirooyin maalgashi; xogta la xaqiijiyay way kooban tahay.

news.title: IGAD iyo Jarmalka oo Jabuuti ku yeeshay wadahadalkooda sannadlaha ah ee iskaashiga
news.summary: Ururka IGAD iyo dowladda Jarmalka ayaa Isniinta xarunta IGAD ee Jabuuti ku qabtay wadahadalkooda iskaashi ee sannadlaha ah, waxayna dib u xaqiijiyeen ballanqaadkooda nabadda, adkaysiga iyo is-dhexgalka gobolka Geeska Afrika, sida uu sheegay war ka soo baxay IGAD. Wafdiga IGAD waxaa hoggaaminayay Xoghayaha Fulinta Dr Workneh Gebeyehu.
news.imageAlt: Xoghayaha Fulinta ee IGAD Workneh Gebeyehu (sawir 2018)
news.imageCredit: U.S. Department of State from United States / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Itoobiya oo goob gaar ah ka furatay shirka COP31 ee Antalya iyadoo u diyaar garoobaysa martigelinta COP32
news.summary: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Itoobiya Gedion Timothewos iyo Wasiirka Maaliyadda Fitsum Assefa ayaa shirka cimilada COP31 ee Antalya, Turkiga, ka furay goobta Itoobiya, iyadoo dalku diyaar u yahay inuu 2027 martigeliyo COP32, sida ay werisay Fana oo xiriir la leh dowladda.
news.imageAlt: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Itoobiya Gedion Timothewos
news.imageCredit: Office of the Prime Minister - Ethiopia / Wikimedia Commons
news.lengthNote: Fana waxay bixisay xog kooban: ma jiraan hadallo toos ah iyo faahfaahinta waxa goobta lagu soo bandhigay.

news.title: Guddoomiye Wetang'ula oo xoojiyay ololaha dib-u-doorashada Ruto ee galbeedka Kenya
news.summary: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Qaranka Kenya Moses Wetang'ula ayaa dadka galbeedka Kenya ugu baaqay inay taageeraan Madaxweyne William Ruto oo u taagan xilli labaad doorashada guud ee 2027, isagoo sheegay in xulafadaasi ay xoojin doonto saameynta gobolka ee dowladda.
news.imageAlt: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Qaranka Kenya Moses Wetang'ula
news.imageCredit: Houses of the Oireachtas / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Nairobi oo la kordhiyay qaybinta biyaha, kaddib markii biyaha xarafka Ndakaini hoos u dhaceen
news.summary: Shirkadda Biyaha iyo Bullaacadaha Magaalada Nairobi ayaa sheegtay in qaybinta biyaha la kordhiyay, maadaama wax-soo-saarka xarumaha Ngethu iyo Kigoro uu hoos u dhacay 35%, kaddib markii biyaha xarafka Ndakaini yaraadeen; waxaa saameyn doonta qaybo ka mid ah Kiambu, Kajiado iyo Machakos.
news.imageAlt: Xarafka biyaha Ndakaini ee u dhow Thika, Kenya
news.lengthNote: Ogeysiis gaaban oo shirkadda biyaha ah; KBC ma bixin heerka kaydka xarafka.

news.title: Museveni oo jaamacadaha Uganda ugu baaqay inay mudnaanta siiyaan tababarka xirfadaha
news.summary: Madaxweyne Yoweri Museveni ayaa jaamacadaha Uganda ugu baaqay inay xoogga saaraan tababarka xirfadaha gacanta si ardaydu u abuuraan shaqooyin, isagoo sheegay in shaqo-la'aantu ay tahay caqabad weyn; khudbadda waxaa jaamacadda Bugema ka akhrisay Ra'iisul Wasaare Robinah Nabbanja.
news.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Uganda Yoweri Museveni
news.imageCredit: U.S. Department of State / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Bangiga Dhexe ee Tanzania: dammaanado 1.6 tirilyan ah ayaa ganacsatada u furay amaah 2.1 tirilyan oo shilin ah
news.summary: Bangiga Dhexe ee Tanzania (BoT) ayaa sheegay inuu bixiyay dammaanado amaah oo dhan 1.6 tirilyan oo shilin, kuwaas oo ganacsatada u fududeeyay amaah dhan 2.1 tirilyan oo shilin oo qaybo kala duwan oo dhaqaalaha ah.
news.imageAlt: Xarunta Bangiga Dhexe ee Tanzania ee Dar es Salaam

news.title: Mareykanka iyo Jasiiradaha Baasifigga oo martigelin doona Koobka Adduunka Rugby League 2030
news.summary: Hay'adda maamusha Rugby League ee caalamka (IRL) ayaa go'aamisay in Koobka Adduunka ee 2030 lagu qabto Mareykanka iyo Jasiiradaha Baasifigga, iyadoo 5-ta magaalo ee martigelinaysa aan weli la shaacin.
news.imageAlt: Koobka Adduunka ee Rugby League oo la soo bandhigay
news.imageCredit: Leeds Library and Information Service / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Holland: Ciyaarta Vitesse iyo De Graafschap oo la joojiyay kadib markii taageerayaal xireen baska kooxdooda
news.summary: Ciyaar heerka labaad ee Holland oo u dhaxaysay Vitesse Arnhem iyo De Graafschap ayaa la joojiyay kadib markii taageerayaasha De Graafschap ay ka hor istaageen baska kooxdooda in uu u ambabaxo ciyaarta.
news.imageAlt: Garoonka GelreDome ee magaalada Arnhem, Holland

news.title: Booliska Kenya oo qabtay 454 kg oo daroogada methamphetamine ah
news.summary: Booliska Kenya ayaa sheegay in ay xeebta dalka ku qabteen 454 kg oo methamphetamine ah oo lagu qiimeeyay $27 milyan, iyagoo xiray 3 qof oo looga shakisan yahay.
news.imageAlt: Muunad daroogada methamphetamine oo dhagax-qurub ah (sawir muujin ah)

news.title: Trump oo sheegay in uu Shiinaha kula kulmi doono Putin iyo Xi
news.summary: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa sheegay in uu filayo in uu kula kulmo Vladimir Putin iyo Xi Jinping shirka Aasiya iyo Baasifigga ee Shenzhen 18–19 November, isagoo sheegay in ay ka wada hadli doonaan hub ka dhigista nukliyeerka iyo joojinta dagaalka Iran.
news.imageAlt: Xi Jinping intii lagu jiray xafladda soo dhoweynta Donald Trump ee Shiinaha, May 2026

news.title: Huckabee: Gargaarka Mareykanka ee Israel si deg-deg ah looma joojin doono
news.summary: Safiirka Mareykanka ee Israel Mike Huckabee ayaa sheegay in gargaarka $4 bilyan ee Washington aan si kedis ah loo joojin doonin, maadaama joojintiisu ay u baahan tahay ogolaanshaha Congress-ka, iyadoo la soo xiganayo i24NEWS.
news.imageAlt: Mike Huckabee oo khudbad ka jeedinaya Des Moines, Iowa

news.title: Ururka Qareennada Kenya oo dalbaday xisaabtan iyadoo qareen Abshir uu weli maqan yahay
news.summary: Ururka Qareennada Kenya (LSK) ayaa ku baaqay in hay'adaha amnigu ay sheegaan meesha uu ku sugan yahay qareen Abshir Ahmedsadak Abdi, waxaana uu ku dhawaaqay bannaanbaxyo cusub Talaadada, maalinta Maxkamadda Sare ee Milimani ay go'aan ka gaari doonto kiiska habeas corpus.
news.imageAlt: Dhismaha garsoorka Kenya ee magaalada Nairobi

news.title: Tanzania: STAMICO oo Dodoma ka furtay warshad shidaal nadiif ah oo ku kacday 3.7 bilyan oo shilin
news.summary: Shirkadda Macdanta ee Dowladda Tanzania (STAMICO) ayaa magaalada Dodoma ka furtay warshadda Rafiki Briquettes oo ku kacday 3.7 bilyan oo shilin, si loo yareeyo ku-tiirsanaanta qoryaha iyo dhuxusha, sida uu werisay wargeyska dowladda ee Daily News.
news.imageAlt: Bartamaha magaalada Dodoma, Tanzania

news.title: Krakow: Ninkii looga shakiyay rasaasta dishay 6 qof oo isbitaal ku geeriyooday
news.summary: Booliska Poland ayaa sheegay in ninka 24 jirka ah ee looga shakiyay in uu dilay ugu yaraan 6 qof rasaas ka dhacday bartamaha Krakow Sabtidii uu isbitaalka ku dhintay subaxnimadii Isniinta.
news.imageAlt: Munaaradda Town Hall iyo Cloth Hall ee fagaaraha suuqa weyn ee Krakow

news.title: TikTok oo Kenya ka tirtirtay in ka badan 750,000 oo muuqaal
news.summary: Shirkadda TikTok ayaa sheegtay in ay Kenya ka saartay 750,185 muuqaal oo ku xadgudbay xeerarkeeda bulshada intii u dhexeysay April ilaa June 2026.
news.imageAlt: Barnaamijka TikTok oo ku jira taleefan gacmeed

news.title: Faa'iidada Vodacom Tanzania oo kor u kacday 183 boqolkiiba
news.summary: Shirkadda Vodacom Tanzania ayaa sheegtay in faa'iidadeeda saafiga ah ay gaartay 117.8 bilyan oo shilin lixdii bilood ee ku egeyd September 2026, halka dakhliga adeegyadu uu 20.8 boqolkiiba kor ugu kacay 1.067 tirilyan oo shilin.
news.imageAlt: Wakiil M-Pesa oo ku sugan Tanzania
news.imageCredit: Flickr User Emil Sjöblom / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Suuqyada saamiyada Aasiya oo soo kabtay kadib hoos u dhacii shirkadaha tiknoolajiyadda
news.summary: Suuqyada saamiyada Aasiya ayaa Isniinta kor u kacay kadib hoos u dhacii toddobaadkii hore ee la xiriiray guusha Xisbiga Dimuqraadiga ee doorashooyinka xilliga dhexe ee Mareykanka, iyadoo Nikkei 225 ee Tokyo uu kor u kacay 3.45%.
news.imageAlt: Dhismaha suuqa saamiyada Tokyo (Tokyo Stock Exchange) ee Japan

news.title: Rubio: Dagaalka Iran lama jecla, laakiin wuxuu ahaa lagama maarmaan si loo joojiyo khatarta nukliyeerka
news.summary: Xoghayaha Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka Marco Rubio ayaa Axaddii sheegay in Madaxweyne Trump uu dagaalka Iran u qaaday si uu adduunka uga ilaaliyo hamiga nukliyeerka Tehran, isagoo tilmaamay in wada-hadallada aysan ku dhowayn horumar.
news.imageAlt: Marco Rubio oo khudbad ka jeedinaya munaasabad

news.title: Soomaaliya, Masar iyo Jabuuti oo sheegay in amniga Badda Cas ay leeyihiin dalalka ku teedsan
news.summary: Wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda Soomaaliya, Masar iyo Jabuuti ayaa Isniintii magaalada Tripoli ee Liibiya ku ballanqaaday in sugidda amniga Badda Cas ay mas'uul ka yihiin dalalka xeebaha la leh.
news.imageAlt: Wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Masar Badr Abdelatty, February 2025
news.imageCredit: U.S. Department of State / Wikimedia Commons
news.sourceRights: facts-only; © Goobjoog Media Group, all rights reserved

news.title: Mexico oo xirtay nin lagu tuhunsan yahay inuu hoggaamiye sare ka yahay kooxda daroogada ee Jalisco
news.summary: Ciidamada badda Mexico ayaa sheegay in Axaddii magaalada Zapopan lagu qabtay Rafael Alvarez oo loo yaqaan "R2", kaas oo lagu tuhunsan yahay inuu madax u yahay qayb ka mid ah kooxda CJNG, iyadoo la adeegsaday xog ay bixisay hay'adda DEA ee Mareykanka.
news.imageAlt: Omar García Harfuch, wasiirka amniga Mexico

news.title: Magaalada New Delhi oo ay qabsatay qiiq sun ah kadib dabbaaldegga Diwali
news.summary: Daruur qiiq iyo wasakh ah ayaa subaxnimadii Isniinta daboolay caasimadda Hindiya kadib markii dadku ay Axaddii ridayeen rashka dabbaaldegga Diwali, iyadoo heerka tayada hawada (AQI) uu dhaafay 350 meelo badan oo magaalada ah.
news.imageAlt: Qiiq iyo wasakh hawo oo daboolay cirka magaalada Delhi
news.imageCredit: wili hybrid Original uploader was Lokantha at en.wikipedia. Later version(s) were uploaded by Nikkul, Thisglad at en.wikipedia. / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Weerar drone ah oo lagu qaaday aag warshadeed oo ku yaal magaalada Kirishi ee Ruushka
news.summary: Guddoomiyaha gobolka Leningrad, Aleksandr Drozdenko, ayaa Telegram ku sheegay in xalay drone-yo ay weerareen aag warshadeed oo ku yaal magaalada Kirishi, oo qiyaastii 150 km u jirta St. Petersburg, isla markaana 113 drone la soo riday, sida ay werisay wakaaladda TT ee Sweden Herald.
news.imageAlt: Xafiiska shirkadda KINEF ee magaalada Kirishi, Ruushka

news.title: Moldova oo daah-furtay khad koronto oo cusub oo ku xiran Romania si ay uga yareyso ku tiirsanaanta Ruushka
news.summary: Moldova ayaa Axaddii si rasmi ah u daah-furtay khad koronto oo cusub oo dalka ku xiraya Romania iyo shabakadda korontada Yurub, iyadoo ujeeddadu tahay in la yareeyo ku tiirsanaanta tamarta Ruushka.
news.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Moldova Maia Sandu

news.title: Wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda G7 oo Paris ku kulmaya; Yurub ayaa Mareykanka kala hadli doonta Ukraine iyo Iran
news.summary: Wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda kooxda G7 ayaa Isniinta Paris ka bilaabaya wadahadallo socon doona 2 maalmood, iyadoo la sheegay in dalalka Yurub ay Mareykanka ku cadaadin doonaan inuu raadiyo xal caddaalad ah oo Ukraine ah, kana fogaado weerarro cusub oo Iran lagu qaado.
news.imageAlt: Wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Mareykanka Marco Rubio
news.imageCredit: U.S. Department of State / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Trump oo sheegay in jagada afhayeenka uu Dana White u soo bandhigay ay ahayd kaftan
news.summary: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa wargeyska The New York Times u sheegay in soo bandhiggii uu jagada afhayeenka Aqalka Cad u soo bandhigay madaxa UFC Dana White uusan ahayn mid dhab ah, isagoo yiri "I was just kidding", iyadoo la soo xiganayo wakaaladda TT.
news.imageAlt: Dana White, madaxa shirkadda UFC

news.title: Biden: Kansarku wuxuu iga yareynayaa wada-hadallada aan ka yeelan lahaa buuggayga
news.summary: Madaxweynihii hore ee Mareykanka Joe Biden ayaa Axaddii baraha bulshada ku sheegay in kansarka uu qabo uu ka hor istaagi doono inuu sameeyo wada-hadallo badan oo uu ku faafiyo buuggiisa xusuusqorka ah.
news.imageAlt: Sawirka Joe Biden, madaxweynihii hore ee Mareykanka
news.imageCredit: The White House - Flickr / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Hakeem Jeffries oo taageeray in xilka laga qaado Wasiirka Difaaca Pete Hegseth
news.summary: Hoggaamiyaha Dimuqraadiyiinta ee Aqalka Wakiilada Mareykanka Hakeem Jeffries ayaa sheegay inuu si buuxda u taageerayo qaraar lagu doonayo xil ka qaadista Wasiirka Difaaca Pete Hegseth, oo uu ku eedeeyay inuu abaabulay dagaalka Iran.
news.imageAlt: Sawirka rasmiga ah ee Hakeem Jeffries, hoggaamiyaha Dimuqraadiyiinta Aqalka Wakiilada Mareykanka
news.imageCredit: Office of Representative Hakeem Jeffries / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Merz oo u magacaabaya Ilse Aigner musharraxa madaxweynaha Jarmalka, haweeneydii ugu horreysay
news.summary: Ra'iisul wasaare Friedrich Merz ayaa Axaddii sheegay inuu Ilse Aigner, guddoomiyaha baarlamaanka gobolka Bavaria, u magacaabi doono musharraxa xisbiyada CDU iyo CSU ee jagada madaxweynaha Jarmalka; haddii la doorto waxay noqon doontaa haweeneydii ugu horreysay ee dalka madax u noqota.
news.imageAlt: Ilse Aigner, guddoomiyaha baarlamaanka gobolka Bavaria

news.title: Shirka cimilada COP31 oo maanta ka furmaya Antalya; Aliyev ayaa ka qeyb geli doona
news.summary: Madaxweynaha Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev ayaa ka qeyb geli doona shirka cimilada ee Qaramada Midoobay ee COP31 oo 9 ilaa 20 Nofembar ka dhacaya magaalada Antalya, waana kii ugu horreeyay ee Turkiga martigeliyo.
news.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev
news.imageCredit: The Official Website of the President of the Republic of Azerbaijan / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Trump oo sheegay inuusan ogeyn in hantidiisu ay kordhay 3 bilyan oo doollar
news.summary: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa barnaamijka 60 Minutes ee CBS News u sheegay inuusan ogeyn in hantidiisu ay kordhay 3 bilyan oo doollar tan iyo markii uu xafiiska dib ugu soo laabtay, isagoo sheegay in arrimahiisa maaliyadeed uu maamulo wiil uu dhalay.
news.imageAlt: Sawirka rasmiga ah ee Madaxweyne Donald Trump

news.title: Baabe Leo XIV oo Buenos Aires ka hortiisa ugu baaqay Milei inuu ilaaliyo dimuqraadiyadda
news.summary: Baabe Leo XIV ayaa khudbaddiisii ugu horreysay ee Buenos Aires ugu baaqay Madaxweyne Javier Milei iyo siyaasiyiinta Argentina inay ilaaliyaan dimuqraadiyadda oo ay si taxaddar leh u adeegsadaan hadalladooda.
news.imageAlt: Baabe Leo XIV oo gacanta u haadinaya dadweynaha

news.title: Trump oo madaxa UFC Dana White u soo bandhigay jagada afhayeenka Aqalka Cad
news.summary: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa Sabtidii bartiisa Truth Social ku sheegay inuu jagada afhayeenka Aqalka Cad u soo bandhigay Dana White, madaxa shirkadda UFC; White ayaa la filayaa inuu Isniinta kula kulmo Trump si ay uga wada hadlaan.
news.imageAlt: Dana White, madaxa shirkadda UFC

news.title: Araghchi: Dhexdhexaadiyayaasha heshiiska Iran iyo Mareykanka safarkoodu wuu istaagay
news.summary: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Iran, Abbas Araghchi, ayaa Axaddii telefishinka dowladda u sheegay in dhexdhexaadiyayaashii ka shaqeynayay heshiis nabadeed oo u dhexeeya Iran iyo Mareykanka ay joojiyeen safarradooda tan iyo doorashooyinkii xilli-dhexaadka ee Mareykanka, oo uu ku tilmaamay "argagax". Wuxuu sheegay in ay waqti qaadan doonto inta jawigu u wanaagsanaanayo dib-u-bilaabidda safarrada.
news.imageAlt: Abbas Araghchi oo kulan la leh Rafael Grossi, agaasimaha IAEA, magaalada Vienna

news.title: Leeds United oo cambaareysay cunsuriyad onlayn ah oo lala beegsaday Jayden Bogle
news.summary: Kooxda Leeds United ayaa cambaareysay cunsuriyad onlayn ah oo ay ku tilmaantay "karaahiyo", taas oo lala beegsaday daafaceeda Jayden Bogle kadib guushii 1-0 ee Sabtidii ay ka gaartay Tottenham. Bogle ayaa lagu eedeeyay tacaddi uu ku sameeyay Mathys Tel oo garsooraha uusan ciqaabin kadib dib-u-eegis VAR ah, halka Tottenham ay sheegtay inay cabasho rasmi ah gudbin doonto.
news.imageAlt: Garoonka Elland Road ee kooxda Leeds United, magaalada Leeds

news.title: Dowladaha Soomaaliya iyo Liibiya oo yeeshay kulan ay uga wada hadleen xoojinta iskaashiga dhaqaalaha iyo maaliyadda
news.summary: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, Abdisalam Ali, ayaa magaalada Tripoli kula kulmay Wasiirka Maaliyadda Liibiya, Rashiid Abuu Qaffah, iyagoo ka wada hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga dhaqaalaha iyo maaliyadda iyo kordhinta dhoofinta xoolaha nool ee Soomaaliya.
news.imageAlt: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya Abdisalam Ali iyo Wasiirka Maaliyadda Liibiya Rashiid Abuu Qaffah oo gacmaha isku qabsanaya, Tripoli

news.title: Trump: "Aad uma badna" in weerarro cusub lagu qaado Iran haddii wadahadalladu horumar sameeyaan
news.summary: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa Axaddii wareysi taleefan ah oo uu siiyay CNN ku sheegay in ay "aad u yar tahay" suurtagalnimada inuu Mareykanku dib ugu laabto dagaal Iran, inta ay horumar ka jiro wadahadallada barnaamijka nukliyeerka iyo dib u furista Marinka Hormuz. Wuxuu sheegay in arrintu ku xiran tahay in Iran ay saxiixdo "heshiis aad u adag".
news.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump oo wareysi bixinaya, sawir 2025

news.title: Koonfur Suudaan: Khilaaf ka dhashay doorashooyinka hordhaca ah ee SPLM ee Greater Pibor
news.summary: Koox ergooyin ah oo ka tirsan xisbiga talada haya ee SPLM ayaa ku eedeeyay guddiga doorashooyinka hordhaca ah ee maamulka Greater Pibor eex iyo inay taageerayaan musharax gaar ah. Hawsha oo socotay ku dhawaad 2 toddobaad ayaa la hakiyay Jimcihii, iyadoo saraakiishu ay sababta ku sheegeen "caqabado farsamo".
news.imageAlt: Muuqaal ka mid ah Pibor, Koonfur Suudaan

news.title: Erdoğan oo Aliyev kala qayb galay xusuusta Maalinta Guusha ee Azerbaijan ee Karabakh
news.summary: Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ayaa Axaddii ka qayb galay xusuusta 6aad ee Maalinta Guusha ee Azerbaijan oo lagu qabtay Karabakh, kadib casuumad uu u fidiyay Madaxweyne Ilham Aliyev. Aliyev ayaa shir jaraa'id oo wadajir ah ku sheegay in midnimada labada dal "ay weligeed sii jiri doonto".
news.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev, sawir 2025

news.title: Ruushka oo sheegay inuu weeraray saldhigyo koronto iyo 3 markab oo Ukraine ah; boqolaal kun oo aan koronto haysan
news.summary: Wasaaradda Difaaca Ruushka ayaa sheegtay in weerarrada habeennimo ay ku dhufteen 3 markab oo xamuul ah oo ay ku eedeysay inay hub u sidayeen Ukraine iyo 2 saldhig oo koronto ah. Waxaa la sheegay in boqolaal kun oo Ukrainians ah ay Axaddii koronto la'aan ku noqdeen weerarrada Ruushka ee kaabayaasha tamarta kadib.
news.imageAlt: Waddo ku taal Kyiv oo mugdi ah kadib weerarro Ruushka ah oo lagu qaaday kaabayaasha tamarta, November 2022

news.title: Norway: Taageerayaal ku dhaawacmay kadib markii qayb ka mid ah garoonka Tromsø ay dumtay
news.summary: Dhowr taageere ayaa ku dhaawacmay, mid ka mid ahna isbitaal ayaa la geeyay, kadib markii qayb ka mid ah meesha taageerayaasha kooxda martida ah ee garoonka Tromsø ay jabtay intii lagu guda jiray ciyaartii Bodø/Glimt ee Axaddii, sida ay sheegeen labada kooxba. Ciyaarta ayaa la joojiyay wax yar ka hor nasashada.
news.imageAlt: Garoonka Alfheim ee magaalada Tromsø, Norway

news.title: Masar: Tirada dhimashada shilka tareennada Giza oo gaartay 4 qof, 88 kalena way dhaawacmeen
news.summary: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Masar ayaa sheegtay in ugu yaraan 4 qof ay ku dhinteen, ku dhawaad 90 kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen kaddib markii laba tareen ay isku dhaceen gobolka Giza, meel u dhow Qaahira. Warbixinnadii hore waxay sheegeen 64 dhaawac iyo in aan la ogeyn dhimasho.
news.imageAlt: Tareen ka mid ah tareennada Hay'adda Tareennada Masar (ENR)

news.title: Amsterdam: Tobanaan kun oo qof oo socod ku dalbaday in dowladda Nederland tallaabo ka qaado Israa'iil
news.summary: Tobanaan kun oo qof oo badankood xirnaa dhar cas ayaa Axaddii socod ku maray magaalada Amsterdam, iyagoo ku cadaadinaya dowladda Nederland inay tallaabo adag ka qaado Israa'iil oo ku saabsan Gaza.
news.imageAlt: Fagaaraha Dam ee bartamaha Amsterdam, oo ay ku yaallaan Qasriga Boqortooyada iyo kaniisadda Nieuwe Kerk

news.title: Juba: Maamulka magaalada oo dib u eegaya hawlgallada amniga ee xaafadaha iyo suuqyada
news.summary: Maamulka magaalada Juba ayaa dib u eegis ku samaynaya hawlgallada amniga ee xaafadaha iyo suuqyada, iyadoo diiradda la saarayo dhallinyarada ku hawlan dilaalnimada aan sharciga ahayn iyo hagaajinta nidaamka guud.
news.imageAlt: Suuq ku yaal magaalada Juba, caasimadda Koonfur Suudaan
news.lengthNote: Warbixinta asalka ah waxay ka warrantay kulan dib-u-eegis ah oo keliya, go'aanno ama tirooyin cusub kuma jirin.

news.title: England oo sugaysa natiijada baaritaanka dhaawaca Marc Guehi ka hor ciyaaraha Nations League
news.summary: Daafaca Manchester City Marc Guehi ayaa Axaddii baaritaan loogu samaynayaa cabasho dhanka sinta ah si loo ogaado inuu toddobaadkan ku biiri karo xulka England. Guehi, 26 jir, ayaa lagu beddelay nasashadii ciyaartii City looga adkaaday Nottingham Forest Sabtidii.
news.imageAlt: Marc Guehi oo ku jira ciyaartii England iyo Panama ee Koobka Adduunka 2026

news.title: Poland: Baaritaan argagixiso oo lagu bilaabay rasaastii Krakow, laba maalmood oo baroor-diiq ahna la ku dhawaaqay
news.summary: Poland ayaa Axaddii baaritaan argagixiso ku bilowday rasaastii Sabtidii ka dhacday fagaaraha weyn ee Krakow ee ay ku dhinteen 6 qof, waxaana dalka lagu dhawaaqay laba maalmood oo baroor-diiq qaran ah. Mas'uuliyiintu waxay sheegeen in tuhmanaha 24 jirka ah uu xiiseynayay fikradaha midigta fog.
news.imageAlt: Dhismaha Pod Złotą Głową ee ku yaal Fagaaraha Suuqa Weyn ee magaalada qadiimiga ah ee Krakow

news.title: Faransiiska: Yurub waxay ka qayb geli doontaa wadahadallada Ukraine ee Abu Dhabi ee uu Mareykanku dhexdhexaadinayo
news.summary: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Faransiiska Jean-Noël Barrot ayaa Axaddii sheegay in reer Yurub laga matali doono, Faransiiskuna uu ka qayb geli doono, wadahadallada nabadda ee Ukraine ee Abu Dhabi ka dhici doona Talaadada iyo Arbacada iyadoo uu dhexdhexaadinayo Mareykanku.
news.imageAlt: Jean-Noël Barrot, Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Faransiiska
news.imageCredit: U.S. Department of State / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Baabe Leo XIV oo ragga ugu baaqay inay xushmeeyaan xaasaskooda, iyadoo Latin America ay ka jirto dhibaatada dilka haweenka
news.summary: Baabe Leo XIV ayaa Axaddii ragga ku booriyay inay xaasaskooda la dhaqmaan si xushmad leh, isagoo soo gabagabaynayay qaybtii koowaad ee socdaalkiisa 12-ka maalmood ah ee Latin America. Gobolka ayaa shantii sano ee la soo dhaafay diiwaangeliyay ku dhawaad 20,000 oo haween ah oo loo dilay jinsigooda.
news.imageAlt: Baabe Leo XIV oo ka muuqda balakoonka kaniisadda Saint Peter kaddib doorashadiisa sannadkii 2025
news.imageCredit: Edgar Beltrán / The Pillar / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Masar: 64 qof oo ku dhaawacmay shil tareen oo ka dhacay koonfurta Qaahira
news.summary: Laba tareen ayaa Axaddii isku dhacay degmada al-Ayyat ee gobolka Giza, koonfurta Qaahira, waxaana ku dhaawacmay 64 qof, sida ay sheegtay Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Masar. Hay'adda tareennada Masar ayaa sheegtay in kooxo gurmad iyo wiishash loo diray si loo nadiifiyo burburka.
news.imageAlt: Tareen ay leedahay shirkadda tareennada Masar (ENR) oo jooga saldhigga Alexandria

news.title: Koonfur Suudaan: Wadahadalka xisbiyada ee doorashada oo dib u furmaya Isniinta si loo ansixiyo go'aannada
news.summary: Hoggaamiyeyaasha xisbiyada siyaasadda ee Koonfur Suudaan ayaa ku heshiiyay inay Isniinta, 9 November, dib ugu kulmaan Juba si ay u dhammaystiraan una ansixiyaan go'aannada wadahadalka la xiriira doorashada ka hor doorashooyinka guud ee December 2026, sida uu sheegay xafiiska Xoghayaha Guud ee SPLM. Taariikhda xafladda xiritaanka ayaa la go'aamin doonaa iyadoo lala tashanayo Madaxweyne Salva Kiir.
news.imageAlt: Dr Akol Paul Kordit, Xoghayaha Guud ee xisbiga SPLM ee Koonfur Suudaan

news.title: Lionel Messi oo noqday ciyaaryahankii ugu horreeyay ee MLS Golden Boot ku guuleysta labo xilli oo xiriir ah
news.summary: Lionel Messi oo u ciyaara Inter Miami ayaa 26 gool ku dhaliyay 31 kulan, isagoo noqday ciyaaryahankii ugu horreeyay taariikhda MLS ee abaalmarinta Golden Boot ku guuleysta labo xilli oo isku xiga, sida uu werisay Nile Post isagoo soo xiganaya BBC Sport. Messi oo 39 jir ah ayaa sidoo kale sameeyay 17 caawin.
news.imageAlt: Lionel Messi oo u ciyaaraya Inter Miami (2025)

news.title: Museveni oo maalgashadayaasha Talyaaniga ugu baaqay inay Uganda ka maalgeliyaan warshadaynta
news.summary: Madaxweynaha Uganda Yoweri Museveni ayaa Entebbe kula kulmay wafdi ka badan 80 qof oo ka socda Talyaaniga, wuxuuna ugu baaqay inay maalgeliyaan warshadaha qaxwada iyo baytariyada lithium. Ra'iisul wasaare Robinah Nabbanja ayaa sheegtay in Talyaanigu u qoondeeyay 120 milyan oo euro qaybta qaxwada Uganda, waxaana kulanka lagu saxiixay heshiis iskaashi horumarineed.
news.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Uganda Yoweri Museveni

news.title: Mareykanka oo sameeyay koox hawleed lagu xannibayo waddooyinka sahayda dhulka ee Iiraan
news.summary: Taliska Dhexe ee Mareykanka (CENTCOM) ayaa sheegay inuu sameeyay koox hawleed cusub oo la yiraahdo Task Force Iron Gate, oo looga golleeyahay joojinta hubka iyo alaabta cunaqabateynta saaran ee mara xuduudaha dhulka ee Iiraan iyo Badda Caspian. CENTCOM ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in tan iyo July 147 markab ganacsi loo leexiyay, halka warbaahinta Iiraan ay werisay qaraxyo ka dhacay jasiiradda Qeshm iyo magaalooyin xeebeed.
news.imageAlt: Marinka Hormuz oo laga arkayo meel u dhow Bandar Abbas, Iiraan

news.title: Jasiiradda El Hierro ee Canary oo ku dhawaaqday xaalad degdeg ah kadib kororka muhaajiriinta
news.summary: Maamulka jasiiradda El Hierro ee Isbaanish ayaa ku dhawaaqay xaalad degdeg ah oo caawimo ka codsaday dowladda Madrid, kadib markii in ka badan 3,300 oo muhaajiriin ah ay ku yimaadeen ilaa 30 doon tan iyo bilowga November, sida ay sheegeen saraakiisha deegaanka. Jasiiraddu waxay leedahay ku dhawaad 11,400 oo qof oo deggan.
news.imageAlt: Tuulada xeebta ah ee La Restinga, jasiiradda El Hierro

news.title: La Liga: Real Madrid oo Valencia kaga badisay 3-0 garoonka Mestalla
news.summary: Real Madrid ayaa Sabtidii 3-0 kaga adkaatay Valencia garoonka Mestalla, iyadoo goolasha ay dhaliyeen Federico Valverde, Arda Güler iyo Kylian Mbappé, natiijadaas oo ay sidoo kale xaqiijisay VAVEL. Guushan, oo ahayd tii siddeedaad oo xiriir ah, ayaa Real Madrid dhibcaha kula siman ka dhigtay Barcelona oo hoggaanka La Liga haysa.
news.imageAlt: Garoonka Mestalla ee magaalada Valencia

news.title: Madaxweynaha Israa'iil oo Gadi Eisenkot u doortay dhisidda dowladda, halkii Netanyahu
news.summary: Madaxweynaha Israa'iil Isaac Herzog ayaa Gadi Eisenkot, hoggaamiyaha xisbiga Yashar, u xilsaaray inuu dhiso dowladda xigta, kadib markii 67 xildhibaan ay taageereen halka Netanyahu uu helay 46. Eisenkot wuxuu haystaa 28 maalmood, oo 14 maalmood lagu kordhin karo, si uu u helo ugu yaraan 61 kursi oo ka mid ah 120-ka kursi ee Knesset-ka.
news.imageAlt: Gadi Eisenkot, hoggaamiyaha xisbiga Yashar

news.title: Faransiiska: in ka badan 140,000 oo qof oo ka dibadbaxay kororka qiimaha nolosha
news.summary: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha Faransiiska ayaa sheegtay in ku dhawaad 146,000 oo qof, oo 46,000 ka mid ah ay joogeen Paris, ay Sabtidii dalka oo dhan ka dibadbaxeen kororka qiimaha nolosha, halka ururrada shaqaaluhu ay sheegeen 250,000. Booliiska ayaa Paris iyo Lyon ku isticmaalay sun dadka ilmeysiisa, waxaana tani ahayd todobaadkii afraad oo xiriir ah ee dibadbaxyada.
news.imageAlt: Dibadbax hore oo ka dhacay waddooyinka Paris (2023)

news.title: Tennis: Carlos Alcaraz oo Casper Ruud ka badiyay, finalka Paris Masters wuxuu la ciyaarayaa Ben Shelton
news.summary: Carlos Alcaraz ayaa semi-finalka Paris Masters kaga adkaaday Casper Ruud 6-4, 6-4, halka Ben Shelton uu Luca Van Assche ka badiyay 5-7, 6-3, 6-4, natiijooyinkaas oo ay sidoo kale xaqiijisay ATP Tour. Alcaraz ayaa sheegay inuu doonayo inuu Shelton ka aar gooyo, kaddib markii uu kaga guuldarraystay kulankoodii u dambeeyay ee US Open.
news.imageAlt: Carlos Alcaraz oo ciyaaraya Roland Garros 2025
news.imageCredit: Like tears in rain / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Mareykanka oo ballan qaaday abaal-marin ilaa $20 milyan ah oo loogu talagalay xog ku saabsan barnaamijka nukliyeerka Iran
news.summary: Barnaamijka Rewards for Justice ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ayaa ku dhawaaqay abaal-marin ilaa $20 milyan ah iyo suurtagalnimada in la raraan qofka keena xog ku saabsan barnaamijka nukliyeerka Iran. Iran ayaa ku adkaysata in barnaamijkeedu yahay mid nabadeed oo aysan dooneynin hub nukliyeer.
news.imageAlt: Dhismaha Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ee Washington
news.imageCredit: U.S. Department of State / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Baabe Leo XIV oo cibaadadiisii ugu horreysay ka qabtay Uruguay, inta lagu jiro socdaal Laatiin Ameerika
news.summary: Baabe Leo XIV ayaa Sabtidii cibaado ka qabtay magaalada Paysandu ee galbeedka Uruguay, taas oo ay ka soo qeybgaleen ku dhawaad 40,000 oo qof sida ay sheegtay Vatican-ka, iyadoo qayb ka ah socdaal 12 maalmood ah oo uu ku marayo Laatiin Ameerika. Booqashadan ayaa timid kadib qalliin sambabada ah oo lagu sameeyay bishii hore, waxaana uu Axadda u gudbayaa Argentina.
news.imageAlt: Baabe Leo XIV (May 2025)
news.imageCredit: Edgar Beltrán / The Pillar / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Arsenal oo 1-0 ku garaacday Hull City goolkii dambe ee Martin Ødegaard
news.summary: Arsenal ayaa Sabtidii garoonka Emirates ku garaacday Hull City 1-0 ciyaar Premier League ah, iyadoo kaptan Martin Ødegaard uu goolka dhaliyay daqiiqaddii 72-aad kadib markii uu ka faa'iideystay laad uu tuuray Noni Madueke.
news.imageAlt: Garoonka Emirates ee kooxda Arsenal, London

news.title: All Blacks oo 43-21 ku garaacday Scotland garoonka Murrayfield
news.summary: Xulka rugby-ga New Zealand ayaa Sabtidii Edinburgh ku garaacay Scotland 43-21 tartanka Nations Championship, iyagoo dhaliyay toddobo try halka Scotland ay dhalisay saddex, sida ay wariyeen BBC Sport iyo bogga rasmiga ah ee All Blacks. Scotland oo qeybtii hore saddex dhibcood oo keliya ka hoosaysay ayaan qeybtii labaad wax dhibic ah keenin.
news.imageAlt: Garoonka Murrayfield ee magaalada Edinburgh

news.title: Poland: Ugu yaraan 6 qof oo lagu dilay rasaas ka dhacday fagaaraha suuqa weyn ee Krakow
news.summary: Booliiska Krakow ayaa sheegay in nin hubaysan oo baabuur wata uu Sabtidii rasaas ku furay dadka ku sugnaa fagaaraha suuqa weyn ee magaalada, isagoo dilay ugu yaraan 6 qof, halka 15 kale ay ku dhaawacmeen. Booliiska ayaa sheegay in tuhmanaha la toogtay oo la dhaawacay, isbitaalna la geeyay.
news.imageAlt: Fagaaraha suuqa weyn ee Krakow (Rynek Główny) iyo kaniisadda St. Mary

news.title: F1: Hamilton iyo Verstappen oo ka bilaabanaya gadaasha safka Grand Prix-ga São Paulo
news.summary: Lewis Hamilton (Ferrari) iyo Max Verstappen (Red Bull) ayaa tartanka Axadda ee São Paulo Grand Prix ka bilaabi doona dhammaadka safka, kadib markii baabuurtooda lagu rakibay matoor cusub oo dhammaystiran. Charles Leclerc ayaa helay ciqaab 10 boos ah, George Russell-na 5 boos.
news.imageAlt: Jidka bilowga ee wareegga Interlagos ee São Paulo, Brazil

news.title: Doorashada New Zealand oo aan lahayn guuleyste cad kadib natiijooyin aad isugu dhow
news.summary: Natiijooyinka hordhaca ah ee doorashadii Sabtida ayaa muujinaya in xisbiga National ee Ra'iisul Wasaare Christopher Luxon uu helay 42 kursi, oo 19 ka yar inta loo baahan yahay, halka xisbiga Labour ee Chris Hipkins uu helay 36. Labada dhinac ayaa u diyaar garoobaya wadahadallo isbahaysi oo laga yaabo inay toddobaadyo qaataan.
news.imageAlt: Dhismayaasha baarlamaanka New Zealand ee magaalada Wellington

news.title: Trump oo Stephen Miller u magacaabay madaxa shaqaalaha Aqalka Cad
news.summary: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa Stephen Miller, oo ahaa ku-xigeenka madaxa shaqaalaha isla markaana dejiyay siyaasadda adag ee socdaalka, u magacaabay inuu beddelo Susie Wiles, kadib khasaaraha taariikhiga ah ee Xisbiga Jamhuuriga ka soo gaaray doorashooyinka xilliga dhexe.
news.imageAlt: Stephen Miller oo saaran diyaaradda Air Force One, 2017

news.title: Kenya: Wax-soo-saarka sonkorta oo kordhay 56.7% iyadoo qiimuhu hoos u dhacay
news.summary: Xogta Guddiga Sonkorta Kenya ayaa muujisay in warshadaha gudaha ay soo saareen 690,521 tan oo sonkor ah intii u dhaxaysay January iyo September 2026, marka la barbardhigo 440,652 tan oo xilligaas la mid ah sannadkii hore. Celceliska qiimaha tafaariiqda ayaa September 2026 hoos ugu dhacay Sh155 halkii kiilo, halka uu ahaa Sh171 September 2025.
news.imageAlt: Cagaf qaadaya qasab sonkoreed oo ku sugan Migori, Kenya

news.title: Ingiriiska oo muwaadiniintiisa uga digay safarka Moyale kadib rabshadaha xadka Itoobiya
news.summary: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Ingiriiska (FCDO) ayaa 6 November muwaadiniinteeda kula talisay inay ka fogaadaan safar aan lagama maarmaan ahayn oo ay ku tagaan magaalada Moyale iyo 5 kiiloomitir oo ku wareegsan xadka Kenya iyo Itoobiya, iyadoo ku sababaysay rabshadaha Itoobiya ee saameeyay dhinaca Kenya. Taliyaha Booliiska Kenya Douglas Kanja ayaa 5 November booqasho amni ku tagay Moyale, wuxuuna sheegay in Kenya ay la xiriirtay Itoobiya si colaadda loo soo afjaro.
news.imageAlt: Waddada u socota Moyale, xadka Kenya iyo Itoobiya

news.title: Wau: Maamulka gobolka oo xiray xafiisyada laba shirkadood oo diyaaradeed khilaaf canshuur $5 ah
news.summary: Maamulka gobolka Western Bahr el Ghazal ee Koonfur Suudaan ayaa xiray xafiisyada shirkadaha Kush Airlines iyo Arojet Airlines ee magaalada Wau, kadib markii ay diideen inay ka qaadaan rakaabka canshuur tigidh oo 5 doolar ah. Mas'uuliyiinta gobolka ayaa sheegay in canshuurtu sharci ku salaysan tahay, isla markaana ay bixiyaan rakaabka ee aysan ahayn shirkadaha.
news.imageAlt: Diyaarad xamuul ah oo ku degaysa garoonka diyaaradaha Wau, Koonfur Suudaan

news.title: Kenya: McDonald Mariga oo laga qaaday jagada ku-xigeenka guddoomiyaha FKF
news.summary: Shir guud oo gaar ah oo Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Kenya (FKF) Sabtidii ku yeeshay Meru ayaa 65 ergo ay u codeeyeen in xilka laga qaado ku-xigeenka guddoomiyaha McDonald Mariga, oo ahaa xiddigii hore ee Inter Milan, iyo 6 xubnood oo kale oo ka tirsan Guddiga Fulinta Qaranka. Guddoomiyaha AFC Leopards Boniface Ambani ayaa ahaa qofka keliya ee ka soo horjeestay.
news.imageAlt: McDonald Mariga oo xilli tababar ku jira
news.imageCredit: Yulia Novikova for Soccer.ru / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Kenya: Paul Mackenzie oo lagu xukumay 200 sano oo xabsi ah dilkii Shakahola
news.summary: Maxkamad ku taal Kenya ayaa Jimcihii hoggaamiyaha kooxda diimeed Paul Mackenzie ku xukuntay 200 sano oo xabsi ah, kadib markii lagu helay dhimashada 190 carruur ah oo gaajo iyo dil loogu geystay kaynta Shakahola. Garsoore Diana Kavedza ayaa sheegtay in xukunku ka kooban yahay 100 sano oo dil gaajo ah iyo 100 sano oo dil toos ah.
news.imageAlt: Webiga Galana ee agagaarka Shakahola, degmada Kilifi, Kenya

news.title: Tanzania oo heshay 1.2 bilyan oo doolar oo lagu dhisayo qaybta Tabora–Kigoma ee tareenka SGR
news.summary: Tanzania ayaa heshay maalgelin dhan 1.2 bilyan oo doolar oo uu soo abaabulay Bangiga Horumarinta Afrika (AfDB), taasoo lagu dhisi doono qaybta 411 kiiloomitir ee Tabora–Kigoma ee jidka tareenka SGR. Heshiiska oo ay ku jiraan 9 bangi ayaa qayb ka ah xirmo maalgelin oo dhan 2.3 bilyan oo doolar, waxaana ku jira dammaanad 800 milyan oo doolar ah oo AfDB bixisay.
news.imageAlt: Rakaab ka degaya tareenka SGR ee Tanzania

news.title: Cricket: Usman Khawaja oo sheegay in kooxda Australia oo dhan ay ogaayeen fadeexaddii kubadda ee 2018
news.summary: Ciyaaryahankii hore ee Australia Usman Khawaja ayaa wargeyska The Sydney Morning Herald u sheegay in dhammaan kooxdu ay ogaayeen qorshihii kubadda lagu xoqay ee 2018 ee loo yaqaan 'Sandpapergate'. Cricket Australia ayaa sheegtay inay ku qanacsan tahay natiijadii baaritaankeedii hore, balse ay tixgelin doonto caddeyn kasta oo cusub.
news.imageAlt: Usman Khawaja intii lagu jiray Ashes 2019

news.title: Soomaaliya oo Wajahaysa Isgoys Halis ah: Ma Laga Baran Doonaa Casharradii Liibiya iyo Suudaan?
news.summary: Khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan arrimaha Dastuurka, Doorashooyinka iyo loollanka awoodda, ayaa halis gelin kara xasilloonida dalka. Waxaa jirta cabsi laga qabo in dalalka shisheeye ay ka faa’iidaystaan kala qaybsanaanta gudaha, sida ka dhacday Liibiya iyo Suudaan. Soomaalida waxaa looga digayaa inay ka heshiiyaan khilaafaadkooda siyaasadeed, kana hortagaan dagaal sokeeye iyo faragelin shisheeye oo halis gelin karta mustaqbalka dalka.
news.imageAlt: Nin xiran suudh buluug ah iyo muraayado, sawir rasmi ah.

news.title: Europa League: Kamada oo daqiiqaddii ugu dambeysay Crystal Palace u badbaadiyay 1-1 ka dhan ah Hoffenheim
news.summary: Crystal Palace ayaa 1-1 la gashay Hoffenheim, kadib markii Daichi Kamada uu gool ku dhaliyay daqiiqadda 90+1, Alexander Prass-na uu Hoffenheim hogaanka u qabtay daqiiqadda 7, sida ay werisay Bundesliga.com. Ciyaaraha kale ee Khamiista, Milan ayaa 0-2 gurigeeda looga adkaaday Ferencváros, halka Bournemouth ay Sparta Praha kaga adkaatay 1-3, sida ay muujinayso liiska natiijooyinka ee UEFA.
news.imageAlt: Ciyaaryahanka Japan Daichi Kamada

news.title: Isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo oo sheegay inuu riday gantaal loo ganay gobolka Madiina
news.summary: Isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo ayaa sheegay inuu dhex-qabtay oo burburiyay gantaal ballistic ah oo Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay u ganeen dhanka gobolka Madiina, kadib markii hay'adda difaaca madaniga ay ka digtay khatar ka jirta agagaarka dekedda Yanbu. Xuutiyiinta ayaa beeniyay in ay bartilmaameedsanayeen magaalada, iyagoo eedeyntaas ku tilmaamay been abuur.
news.imageAlt: Muuqaal guud oo laga qaaday magaalada Madiina ee Sacuudi Carabiya
news.imageCredit: collage bird's eye v… / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: George Russell oo sheegay inuu si qoto dheer isu qiimeyn doono kadib xilli ciyaareed niyad jab ah
news.summary: Darawalka Mercedes George Russell ayaa sheegay inuu si qoto dheer isu eegi doono si uu u ogaado sida uu u horumarin karo kadib xilli ciyaareedka 2026 oo uu ku tilmaamay mid niyad jab ah. Russell wuxuu ku guuleystay 3 tartan oo keliya, halka saaxiibkiisa kooxda Kimi Antonelli uu ku guuleystay 9 tartan isagoo noqday horyaalka ugu da'da yar taariikhda Formula 1.
news.imageAlt: Darawalka Mercedes George Russell oo ku jira Grand Prix-ga Talyaaniga 2025

news.title: Guddoomiyaha California Newsom oo xukunnada dilka ee 548 maxbuus u beddelay xabsi daa'im
news.summary: Guddoomiyaha gobolka California Gavin Newsom ayaa xukunnada dilka ee dhammaan 548-ka qof ee gobolkaas ku xukunnaa dil u beddelay xabsi daa'im ah. Go'aanka ayaa inta badan loo arkaa mid calaamad ah, maadaama California aysan qof dil ku fulin tan iyo 2006, waxaana uu yimid xilli Newsom loo tilmaamayo musharax suurtagal ah.
news.imageAlt: Guddoomiyaha gobolka California Gavin Newsom

news.title: Iiraan oo sheegtay in markab-shidaal dhowr ah ay ku gubteen Marinka Hormuz
news.summary: Ciidamada Ilaalada Kacaanka Iiraan ayaa sheegay in ugu yaraan 5 markab oo shidaal qaada iyo doon jiid ah ay dab ku qabsaday dhacdooyin kala duwan oo ka dhacay Marinka Hormuz. Iiraan ayaa sheegtay in mid ka mid ah maraakiibta uu ku dhacay miino, xilli dagaalka Mareykanka iyo Israa'iil ay la galeen Iiraan uu weli xal la'aan yahay.
news.imageAlt: Sawir hawada sare laga qaaday oo muujinaya Marinka Hormuz

news.title: Eritrea: Madaxweyne Isaias Afwerki oo la kulmay ergayga gaarka ah ee Shiinaha u qaabilsan Geeska Afrika
news.summary: Madaxweyne Isaias Afwerki ayaa 5 November magaalada Asmara kula kulmay Hu Changchun, ergayga gaarka ah ee Shiinaha u qaabilsan arrimaha Geeska Afrika, waxayna ka wada hadleen xiriirka labada dal iyo xaaladda gobolka, sida ay sheegtay Wasaaradda Warfaafinta Eritrea. Hu ayaa ku celiyay mowqifka Shiinaha ee ah in la ixtiraamo madaxbannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee Eritrea.
news.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Eritrea Isaias Afwerki
news.imageCredit: Presidential Executive Office of Russia / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Uganda oo u diyaargarowday inay bacrimin bilaash ah u qaybiso beeralayda yaryar ee qaxwada
news.summary: Dowladda Uganda ayaa diyaarineysa qaybinta bacrimin bilaash ah oo la siinayo beeralayda yaryar ee qaxwada ee degmooyin la doortay, si wax-soosaarka loo kordhiyo. Wargeysku wuxuu sheegay in in ka badan 27 gaari oo bacrimin ah lagu dejiyay Entebbe, iyo in shirkadda Intracom Fertilizers loo xilsaaray keenista bacrimin dabiici ah oo loogu talagalay qaxwada, kookaha iyo shaaha.
news.imageAlt: Beeralay goosanaya midhaha qaxwada
news.lengthNote: Maqaalka asalka ah ma sheegin degmooyinka, qiimaha iyo tirada beeralayda; xog dheeraad ah lama helin.

news.title: Saamiyada tiknoolajiyada iyo AI-da oo hoos u dhacay kadib doorashada Mareykanka
news.summary: Suuqyada saamiyada Mareykanka ayaa Khamiistii hoos u dhacay, iyadoo Nasdaq ay hoos u dhacday 4.8 boqolkiiba, S&P 500 3.6 boqolkiiba, Dow Jones-na 2.8 boqolkiiba duhurkii. Waxaa la sheegay in saamiyada SpaceX ay in ka badan 9 boqolkiiba dhaceen, kuwa Tesla-na in ka badan 11 boqolkiiba, xilli maalgashadayaashu ka walaacsan yihiin xakameyn la saari karo xarumaha xogta iyo warshadaha AI.
news.imageAlt: Dhismaha suuqa saamiyada New York ee Wall Street

news.title: Madaxweynaha Paraguay Santiago Peña oo iscasilay kadib burburka bangiga ueno
news.summary: Madaxweynaha Paraguay Santiago Peña ayaa iscasilay Khamiistii, kadib markii burburka bangiga dijitaalka ah ee ueno uu malaayiin macaamiil ah ka reebay inay galaan xisaabaadkooda, mucaaradkuna ay bilaabeen tallaabooyin xil ka qaadis ah. Peña ayaa sheegay inuu go'aankan u qaatay xasilloonida dalka iyo ilaalinta hay'adaha dimuqraadiga, halka Ku-xigeenka Madaxweynaha Pedro Alliana la filayo inuu xilka la wareego.
news.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Paraguay Santiago Peña

news.title: Itoobiya iyo Shiinaha oo saxiixday deeq 15 milyan oo doollar ah oo loogu talagalay tareenka Itoobiya iyo Jabuuti
news.summary: Dowladaha Itoobiya iyo Shiinaha ayaa Addis Ababa ku saxiixday heshiis deeq ah oo 15 milyan oo doollar ah oo lagu xoojinayo shaqada iyo dayactirka khadka tareenka Itoobiya iyo Jabuuti. Heshiiska waxaa saxiixay Wasiiru Dowlaha Maaliyadda Tiguist Fisseha iyo Liu Xiaoguang oo ka tirsan safaaradda Shiinaha, wuxuuna ka kooban yahay qalab beddel ah oo loogu talagalay tareennada korontada iyo tababar farsamo.
news.imageAlt: Tareen ka tirsan shirkadda tareennada Itoobiya oo saaran khadka
news.lengthNote: Ilaha ayaa bixiya xog kooban oo ku saabsan heshiiska; tirada iyo jadwalka fulinta lama shaacin.

news.title: Kenya: Maxkamad ku taal Malindi oo hakisay shaqaalaysiinta madaxa fulinta ee IEBC
news.summary: Maxkamadda Shaqada iyo Xiriirka Shaqaalaha ee Malindi ayaa si ku meel gaar ah u hakisay shaqaalaysiinta Xoghayaha iyo Madaxa Fulinta ee Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka iyo Xuduudaha (IEBC), iyadoo joojisay wareysiyadii loo qorsheeyay 12 iyo 13 November. Amarka Garsoore J.N. Abuodha wuxuu ka dhashay dacwad uu gudbiyay Thomas Kennedy Balala, wuxuuna socon doonaa ilaa dhageysiga labada dhinac ee 17 November.
news.imageAlt: Astaanta Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka iyo Xuduudaha Kenya (IEBC)

news.title: Kozo Tashima oo ka mid ah madaxda kubadda Japan oo u tartamaya guddoomiyaha FIFA isagoo ka horyimid Infantino
news.summary: Kozo Tashima, guddoomiyaha sharafeed ee Ururka Kubadda Cagta Japan, ayaa Khamiistii ku dhawaaqay inuu Gianni Infantino kula tartami doono doorashada guddoomiyaha FIFA ee bisha March. Tashima oo 68 jir ah, horayna uga mid ahaa Golaha FIFA, ayaa noqday qofka labaad ee ku dhawaaqa musharaxnimo, kadib difaacii hore ee Tottenham Ramon Vega.
news.imageAlt: Xarunta FIFA ee magaalada Zürich

news.title: Armenia oo qorsheyneysa inay 2027 ama 2028 codsi xubinnimo u gudbiso Midowga Yurub
news.summary: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Armenia Nikol Pashinyan ayaa Khamiista sheegay in dalkiisu 2027 ama 2028 si rasmi ah u gudbin doono codsi uu ku doonayo xubinnimo buuxda oo Midowga Yurub. Hadalkan ayaa imanaya xilli xiriirka Armenia iyo xulafadeedii muddada dheer ee Ruushka uu sii xumaanayo.
news.imageAlt: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Armenia Nikol Pashinyan oo khudbad ka jeedinaya Baarlamaanka Yurub ee Strasbourg sannadkii 2023

news.title: Hakimi, Mané, Semenyo iyo Díaz oo ka mid ah musharixiinta Abaalmarinta CAF 2026
news.summary: Achraf Hakimi oo ah ciyaaryahankii ku guuleystay abaalmarintii hore, Sadio Mané, Antoine Semenyo iyo Brahim Díaz ayaa ku jira liiska musharixiinta ragga ee Abaalmarinta CAF 2026. Abaalmarinta ayaa la bixin doonaa 7-da bisha soo socota magaalada Lagos ee Nigeria.
news.imageAlt: Achraf Hakimi oo u ciyaaraya Morocco kulankii ay la ciyaareen Norway 7 June 2026

news.title: Cristiano Ronaldo oo ka fariistay ciyaaraha xulka qaranka Portugal
news.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo oo 41 jir ah ayaa ku dhawaaqay inuu ka fariistay ciyaaraha xulka Portugal, isagoo u ciyaaray 234 kulan kuna dhaliyay 146 gool tan iyo 2003, labaduba rikoor adduun. Ronaldo ayaa muuqaal uu soo dhigay Instagram ku sheegay in ay timid maalintii uu celin lahaa funaanadda lambarka 7.
news.imageAlt: Cristiano Ronaldo oo xiran funaanadda xulka Portugal intii lagu jiray kulan saaxiibtinimo oo Portugal iyo Argentina ku dhex maray Geneva

news.title: Sacuudi Carabiya iyo Suuriya oo saxiixay heshiis iskaashi difaac
news.summary: Sacuudi Carabiya iyo Suuriya ayaa Arbacadii saxiixay heshiis iskaashi difaac xilli Madaxweynaha Suuriya Ahmed al-Sharaa uu booqasho ku joogay Riyadh, sida ay werisay wakaaladda wararka dowladda Sacuudiga SPA oo ay soo xigatay Daily Sabah. Al-Sharaa ayaa la kulmay Amiirka dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga Maxamed bin Salmaan; faahfaahinta heshiiska lama shaacin.
news.imageAlt: Amiirka dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga Maxamed bin Salmaan iyo Madaxweynaha Suuriya Ahmed al-Sharaa oo la jooga Madaxweyne Donald Trump intii uu booqashada ku joogay Sacuudiga 2025

news.title: Shaqo joojin iyo dibadbaxyo qaran oo ka dhacay Faransiiska
news.summary: Shan urur oo shaqaale ayaa ku biiray maalin shaqo joojin iyo dibadbax qaran ah oo ka dhacday Faransiiska, iyagoo dalbanaya mushahar sare iyo ilaalinta adeegyada dadweynaha. Mas'uuliyiinta ayaa filayay 500,000 ilaa 700,000 dibadbaxayaal, halka Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha Laurent Nuñez uu sheegay in la geeyay 70,000 boolis iyo jandarma.
news.imageAlt: Dibadbax shaqaale oo ka dhacay Paris bishii January 2020, kaas oo ka dhan ahaa dib-u-habaynta hawlgabka

news.title: Kenya: Guddiga Farmashiyaha oo ka digay isticmaalka khaldan ee kiniinka cetirizine
news.summary: Guddiga Farmashiyaha iyo Sunta ee Kenya (PPB) ayaa dadweynaha uga digay inay kiniinka cetirizine u isticmaalaan ujeedo aan loogu talagalin oo lagu faafinayo baraha bulshada, isagoo sheegay in aysan jirin caddayn saynis ah oo taageeraysa. Guddiga ayaa xusay in cetirizine uu yahay daawo xasaasiyadda oo afka laga qaato, sida uu tilmaamo xirfadlaha caafimaadku.
news.imageAlt: Kiniinka cetirizine, daawo xasaasiyadda oo afka laga qaato

news.title: Alan Jones, horyaalkii Formula 1 ee 1980, oo geeriyooday isagoo 80 jir ah
news.summary: Alan Jones, oo ahaa darawalkii ugu dambeeyay ee Australia iyo kii ugu horreeyay ee kooxda Williams ku guuleysta horyaalnimada adduunka ee Formula 1, ayaa geeriyooday isagoo 80 jir ah. Xaaskiisa Amanda Butler-Davis ayaa bayaan ay Motorsport Australia faafisay ku sheegtay inuu dhintay 5 November kadib xanuun gaaban; Jones wuxuu ku guuleystay 12 tartan oo Grand Prix ah.
news.imageAlt: Gaariga Williams FW07B ee Alan Jones uu ku guuleystay horyaalnimada Formula 1 ee 1980
news.imageCredit: Ben Sutherland from Crystal Palace, London, UK / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Tanzania: Maxkamadda Sare oo 6 November xukun ka gaadhaysa dacwadda Tundu Lissu
news.summary: Maxkamadda Sare ee Tanzania, laanta Dar es Salaam, ayaa 6 November xukun ka soo saari doonta dacwadda khiyaano qaran ee lagu soo oogay guddoomiyaha xisbiga mucaaradka Chadema Tundu Lissu. Guddi ka kooban saddex garsoore oo uu hoggaaminayo Garsoore Dunstan Ndunguru ayaa go'aamin doona in la xukumo ama la sii daayo.
news.imageAlt: Tundu Lissu oo khudbad ka jeedinaya baarlamaanka Tanzania ee Dodoma

news.title: Melania Trump oo Aqalka Cad ku martigelinaysa saraakiil Ukraine iyo Ruushka ah
news.summary: Marwada Koowaad ee Mareykanka Melania Trump ayaa Khamiista Aqalka Cad ku martigelinaysa saraakiil ka socda Moscow iyo Kyiv, ka hor wadahadallo Abu Dhabi lagu doonayo in lagu soo afjaro dagaalka Ukraine. Wakaaladda TASS oo soo xiganaysa afhayeenka Kremlin Dmitry Peskov ayaa sheegtay in Kirill Dmitriev iyo Yana Lantratova ay la kulmi doonaan haddii qabanqaabadu suurtagasho, halka wakiilka xuquuqda aadanaha ee Ukraine Dmytro Lubinets uu sheegay inuu isna la kulmi doono.
news.imageAlt: Sawirka rasmiga ah ee Aqalka Cad ee Marwada Koowaad Melania Trump, 2025

news.title: Saynisyahannada CERN oo helay caddayn ku saabsan isbeddel qayb-yar oo aad u dhif ah
news.summary: Saynisyahannada CERN ayaa iyagoo adeegsanaya Large Hadron Collider helay caddayn muujinaysa hab aad u dhif ah oo qayb-yar oo loo yaqaan 'beauty particle' ay isugu beddesho qaybo kale, kaas oo la saadaaliyay inuu dhaco hal mar 10 bilyan oo jeer kiiba. Cilmibaarayaashu waxay sheegeen in arrintani ay fursad u tahay baaritaanka waxa ay ugu yeeraan 'zeptoverse'.
news.imageAlt: Tunnelka Large Hadron Collider ee CERN

news.title: QM oo ka digtay in Koonfur Suudaan ay Abyei ku darto doorashooyinka
