news.summary: Xoghayaha Guud ee QM António Guterres ayaa warbixin uu u gudbiyay Golaha Ammaanka ku sheegay in qorshaha Koonfur Suudaan ee ah inay gobolka lagu muransan yahay ee Abyei ku darto doorashooyinka guud ee December 2026 uu kordhin karo xiisadda Suudaan. Suudaan ayaa 13 July si rasmi ah uga cabatay go'aankan, iyadoo sheegtay inuu jebinayo heshiisyada labada dal.
news.imageAlt: Muuqaal guud oo laga qaaday magaalada Abyei

news.title: Como oo Lens ku garaacday 9-1, waxayna la siman tahay rikoorka Champions League
news.summary: Kooxda Como ee uu tababaro Cesc Fàbregas ayaa garoonka Lens kaga adkaatay 9-1, iyadoo Anastasios Douvikas uu dhaliyay saddex gool. Sagaalka gool ayaa la siman tirada ugu badan ee hal kooxeed ku dhalisay ciyaar Champions League, kaddib guushii Bayern Munich ee 9-2 ay ka gaartay Dinamo Zagreb 2024.
news.imageAlt: Garoonka Stade Bollaert-Delelis ee magaalada Lens

news.title: QM: Rasaas ayaa waxyeellaysay teendhooyin barakacayaal oo ku yaal Rafah
news.summary: Xafiiska Isku-duwidda Gargaarka ee QM (OCHA) ayaa sheegay in rasaas ay ku dhacday oo ay waxyeellaysay teendhooyin badan oo ku yaal goob barakacayaal oo ku taal waqooyiga Rafah ee Gaza, isla markaana dad ay ku dhaawacmeen. Afhayeenka Xoghayaha Guud Stephane Dujarric ayaa sheegay in rayidka iyo shaqaalaha gargaarka ay tahay in la ilaaliyo.
news.imageAlt: Teendhooyinka barakacayaasha Falastiiniyiinta ee aagga Al-Mawasi ee Marinka Gaza oo hawada laga sawiray

news.title: Champions League: Real Madrid oo AEK ku garaacday 3-2, Liverpool oo Fenerbahce 3-2 looga adkaaday
news.summary: Real Madrid ayaa garoonka AEK Athens kaga adkaatay 3-2 kaddib gool daqiiqadihii dheeriga ahaa uu dhaliyay Federico Valverde, iyadoo Jude Bellingham iyo Kylian Mbappé ay sidoo kale dhaliyeen, sida ay werisay bogga rasmiga ah ee Real Madrid. Liverpool ayaa Istanbul looga adkaaday 3-2, iyadoo Muriqi uu goolka guusha u dhaliyay Fenerbahce, sida uu xaqiijiyay bogga Liverpool.
news.imageAlt: Federico Valverde oo ciyaaraya isagoo xiran funaanadda Real Madrid
news.imageCredit: All-Pro Reels from District of Columbia, USA / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: UNCTAD: Dalalka soo koraya ayaa ugu culays badan qiimaha shidaalka
news.summary: Warbixin cusub oo ay soo saartay UNCTAD ayaa sheegtay in dalalka soo koraya ay ugu culays badnaayeen kororka qiimaha shidaalka ka dib markii dagaalku xiray Marinka Hormuz bishii Febraayo. Tusaale ahaan, naaftada Nigeria ayaa qiyaastii 83% kor u kacday intii u dhaxaysay dhammaadkii Febraayo iyo dhammaadkii Agoosto, halka Ireland ay ku kordhay 9%.
news.imageAlt: Matoor shidaal oo yaal saldhig shidaal

news.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo xilka ka qaaday Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare
news.summary: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa xilka ka qaaday Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare Baashe Yuusuf Axmed, wuxuuna booskiisa u magacaabay Ibraahim Iidle Suleymaan, sida lagu sheegay war ka soo baxay Madaxtooyada. Madaxtooyada ayaa sheegtay in go'aanka lagu salaynayo cabashooyin ka yimid garsoorayaal iyo xirfadlayaal sharci, halka la sheegay in mucaaradku ay ku tilmaameen tallaabadan mid wiiqaysa madaxbannaanida garsoorka.
news.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo la hadlaya saxaafadda

news.title: Weerarro diyaaradaha drone-ka ah oo saddex qof ku dilay gobolka Belgorod ee Ruushka
news.summary: Mas'uuliyiinta maxalliga ah ee Ruushka ayaa sheegay in weerarro drone oo Ukraine ah ay saddex qof ku dileen gobolka Belgorod. Madaxweyne Volodymyr Zelenskyy ayaa sheegay in weerarradii habeenkii ee Ruushku ay waxyeelleeyeen xarumo koronto iyo saldhigyo tamar oo ku yaal sagaal gobol, taasoo keentay go'itaan koronto.
news.imageAlt: Magaalada Belgorod ee Ruushka oo laga sawiray hawada

news.title: Trump: Dagaalka Iiraan wuu saameeyay doorashada, laakiin waxaan sameeyay waxa saxda ah
news.summary: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa qiray in weerarka Iiraan iyo qiimaha sare ee shidaalku ay saameeyeen khasaaraha Xisbiga Jamhuuriga ee doorashada xilli-dhexaadka, balse wuxuu u sheegay Wall Street Journal: "Waxaan sameeyay waxa saxda ah,". Ku-xigeenka Madaxweynaha JD Vance ayaa isna ku qoray X in sababta looga guuldarraystay ay tahay dagaalka.
news.imageAlt: Sawirka rasmiga ah ee Ku-xigeenka Madaxweynaha Mareykanka JD Vance

news.title: Soomaaliya oo meel marisay qorshe lix bilood ah oo lagu gaarayo carruurta aan la tallaalin
news.summary: Guddiga Qaranka ee Tallaalka iyo Ciribtirka Dabaysha oo uu shir guddoominayay Ra'iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre ayaa ansixiyay qorshe lix bilood ah oo lagu ballaarinayo tallaalka carruurta. Sida ay sheegeen WHO iyo UNICEF, ilaa 1.5 milyan oo carruur Soomaaliyeed ah oo ka yar shan sano ayaan weligood helin tallaal joogto ah.
news.imageAlt: Wiil Soomaali ah oo lagu siinayo tallaalka dabaysha isbitaal ku yaal Muqdisho
news.imageCredit: PV2 Andrew W. McGalliard / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Xiriirka Xeegada Barafka ee Caalamka oo weli diidan go'aanka dib loogu soo celiyay Ruushka
news.summary: Xiriirka Xeegada Barafka ee Caalamka (IIHF) ayaa sheegay inuu weli ku diidan yahay go'aanka Maxkamadda Garqaadka Isboortiga (CAS) ee meesha ka saaray mamnuucii Ruushka, isagoo ka digay caqabado la xiriira fiisooyinka iyo amniga. Norway, Denmark, Sweden iyo Czech Republic ayaa sheegay in kooxahoodu aysan la ciyaari doonin Ruushka Koobka Adduunka ee sanadka dambe ka dhacaya Jarmalka.
news.imageAlt: Ciyaar xeegada barafka ah oo dhex martay Sweden iyo Switzerland Koobkii Adduunka ee IIHF 2019

news.title: Rory McIlroy oo taageeray in ciyaartoydii LIV dib loogu oggolaado DP World Tour
news.summary: Xiddigga golf-ka Rory McIlroy ayaa taageeray go'aanka DP World Tour ee ah in ciyaartoydii hore ee LIV Golf sida Jon Rahm iyo Sergio Garcia dib loogu oggolaado 2027. McIlroy ayaa sheegay in LIV ay xirfadda golf-ka u rogtay 'tartan hub', isagoo ku baaqay hab ganacsi oo waara.
news.imageAlt: Ciyaaryahanka golf-ka Rory McIlroy

news.title: Xisbiga Dimuqraadiga oo la wareegay labada aqal ee Congress-ka Mareykanka
news.summary: Dimuqraadiyiintu waxay dib ula wareegeen Aqalka Wakiillada waxayna Golaha Guurtida ka qabsadeen ugu yaraan lix kursi, taasoo siisay maamulka Congress-ka oo dhan. Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa sheegay inuusan codbixinta ku jirin, halka Hakeem Jeffries uu ku tilmaamay natiijada bilowga soo laabashada Mareykanka.
news.imageAlt: Dhismaha Capitol-ka Mareykanka ee magaalada Washington

news.title: Abdul El-Sayed oo noqday senetarkii ugu horreeyay ee Muslim ah ee Mareykanka
news.summary: Musharraxa Dimuqraadiga Abdul El-Sayed ayaa kaga guuleystay Mike Rogers kursiga Golaha Guurtida ee gobolka Michigan, wuxuuna noqonayaa senetarkii ugu horreeyay ee Muslim ah ee dalkaas. El-Sayed, 42 jir oo waalidkiis ka soo haajireen Masar, ayaa sheegay in ololihiisu muujiyay in 'dadka badani ay ka adkaan karaan lacagta'.
news.imageAlt: Abdul El-Sayed oo ka hadlaya dhageysi guddi Golaha Guurtida Mareykanka
news.imageCredit: U.S. Senate Committee on Health, Education, Labor and Pensions / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Wasiirka Gaadiidka Isbaanishka oo is casilay kadib shil tareen oo dilay 69 qof
news.summary: Wasiir Óscar Puente ayaa is casilay wax ka yar toddobaad kadib shilkii tareenka ee khadka Madrid iyo Seville, wuxuuna sheegay in wasiir aanu xilka sii hayn karin kadib laba shil oo culus muddo sanad gudihiis ah. Ra'iisul Wasaare Pedro Sánchez ayaa ku dhawaaqay gargaar dhan €30 milyan.
news.imageAlt: Sawirka Óscar Puente oo ah wasiirka gaadiidka Isbaanishka

news.title: Koonfur Afrika oo u codeysay doorashooyinka golaha deegaanka, imtixaan u ah ANC
news.summary: Guddiga doorashooyinka IEC ayaa sheegay in 29.2 milyan oo qof oo rikoor ah ay isu diiwaangeliyeen codbixinta golayaasha deegaanka, taasoo loo arko imtixaan u ah xisbiga ANC. Madaxweyne Cyril Ramaphosa ayaa qoray in fashilka dowladaha hoose uu hoos u dhigay kalsoonida shacabka; natiijada kama dambaysta ah waxaa la filayaa Axadda.
news.imageAlt: Codbixiyeyaal safaf ku jira oo ku sugan goob codbixineed oo Koonfur Afrika ah

news.title: Xiddiggii baseball-ka Mark Teixeira oo ku guuleystay kursi Aqalka Wakiillada Mareykanka
news.summary: Mark Teixeira, oo saddex jeer ka qayb galay ciyaarta All-Star ee MLB, ayaa xisbiga Jamhuuriga ugu guuleystay kursiga degmada 21aad ee gobolka Texas, isagoo ka adkaaday Dimuqraadiga Kristin Hook. Kursigan waxaa horay u hayay Chip Roy oo aan dib u tartamin.
news.imageAlt: Mark Teixeira oo xiran dirayska kooxda New York Yankees

news.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo diiday safiirka Israa'iil u magacawday Hargeysa iyo safaaradda la qorsheeyay
news.summary: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ayaa sheegtay in magacaabista safiirka iyo dhagax-dhigga safaarad Israa'iil ka furto Hargeysa aan la helin oggolaanshaha dowladda federaalka oo aysan lahayn wax saameyn sharci ah. Wasaaraddu waxay sheegtay inay qaadi doonto tallaabooyin diblomaasiyadeed, siyaasadeed iyo sharci, waxayna ugu baaqday Israa'iil inay dib uga noqoto.
news.imageAlt: Muuqaal guud oo laga qaaday magaalada Hargeysa

news.title: Jon Ossoff oo dib ugu guuleystay kursiga Senate-ka ee gobolka Georgia
news.summary: Senetar Jon Ossoff oo ka tirsan xisbiga Dimuqraadiga ayaa doorashada dhexe ee Mareykanka kaga adkaaday musharraxa Jamhuuriga Mike Collins. Markii 56% codadka la tiriyay, Ossoff wuxuu helay 63% halka Collins helay 29%; xisbiga maamuli doona labada aqal ee Congress-ka weli lama shaacin.
news.imageAlt: Sawirka rasmiga ah ee Senetar Jon Ossoff
news.imageCredit: U.S. Senate Photographic Studio / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Golaha Wakiillada Puntland oo su'aalo weydiiyay madaxda Wasaaradda Waxbarashada
news.summary: Golaha Wakiillada Puntland oo uu shir guddoominayay Guddoomiye Cabdirisaaq Axmed Siciid ayaa dhageystay warbixinta Wasaaradda Waxbarashada iyo Tacliinta Sare, kadibna xildhibaanno ayaa su'aalo ka weydiiyay waxqabadka iyo adeegyada waxbarashada.
news.imageAlt: Fadhi ay yeesheen Golaha Wakiillada Puntland ee magaalada Garoowe

news.title: Ilhan Cumar oo markii shanaad loo doortay Aqalka Wakiillada Mareykanka
news.summary: Xildhibaan Ilhan Cumar oo ka tirsan xisbiga Dimuqraadiga ayaa dib loogu doortay kursiga degmada 5aad ee gobolka Minnesota, oo ay matalaysay tan iyo 2019. Khudbaddeeda guusha ayay ugu mahadcelisay taageerayaasheeda, oo badankood Soomaali ah.
news.imageAlt: Sawirka rasmiga ah ee Xildhibaan Ilhan Cumar
news.imageCredit: Kristie Boyd; U.S. House Office of Photoraphy / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga oo ka wada hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga milatari iyo amniga
news.summary: Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa Muqdisho kula kulmay Jeneraal Sabahattin Kılınç oo ka socda taliska guud ee ciidamada Turkiga, waxayna ka wada hadleen iskaashiga difaaca, amniga Geeska Afrika iyo dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab. Fiqi ayaa ammaanay taageerada Turkiga ee tababarka iyo qalabeynta ciidamada Soomaaliyeed.
news.imageAlt: Askar Soomaaliyeed oo tababar milatari ku jira dalka Turkiga

news.title: Dowladda: Bixitaanka ciidamada Uganda micnaheedu maaha in dhammaan ciidamadeedu baxayaan
news.summary: Lataliyaha Amniga Qaranka Safiir Aweys Xaaji Yuusuf Axmed ayaa sheegay in ciidamada baxaya ay yihiin kuwa la keenay heshiis laba dal, halka ciidamada Uganda ee AUSSOM ay sii joogi doonaan. Ciidamada UPDF ayaa horay u sheegay in dhammaan ciidamadooda Soomaaliya ay bixi doonaan dhammaadka 2027.
news.imageAlt: Gaadiid ciidamada Uganda ee Midowga Afrika oo roondo ku maraya magaalada Qoryooley

news.title: Boqor Charles oo ka muujiyay murugo qoto dheer ganacsigii addoonsiga, balse aan raali-gelin bixin
news.summary: Boqorka Ingiriiska Charles III ayaa furitaanka shirka madaxda Barwaaqo-sooranka (CHOGM) ee St John's, Antigua iyo Barbuda, ka sheegay in ganacsigii addoonsiga ee Atlantic-ga uu ku abuuray naxdin iyo murugo shakhsi ah oo qoto dheer. Ma uusan bixin raali-gelin rasmi ah, halka Madaxweynaha Guyana Mohamed Irfaan Ali uu sheegay in raali-gelintu ay noqoto tallaabada xigta.
news.imageAlt: Boqorka Ingiriiska Charles III

news.title: Baarlamaanka Greenland oo ansixiyay heshiis amni oo lala galay Mareykanka iyo Denmark
news.summary: Baarlamaanka Greenland ayaa Talaadadii heshiiska ku ansixiyay 16 cod oo haa ah iyo 0 diid ah, iyadoo 7 xildhibaan ay ka aamuseen. Heshiisku wuxuu Mareykanka u oggolaanayaa inuu ballaariyo hawlihiisa saldhigga Pituffik Space Base, wuxuuna dhaqan geli doonaa marka baarlamaanka Denmark iyo Greenland ay dhammaystiraan nidaamyada loo baahan yahay.
news.imageAlt: Saldhigga Pituffik (Thule Air Base) ee waqooyiga Greenland oo hawada laga sawiray

news.title: Barcelona oo 3-0 ku garaacday Aston Villa, PSG oo 6-0 ku jebisay Villarreal
news.summary: Lamine Yamal (daqiiqadda 7aad) iyo Raphinha oo laba gool dhaliyay (52 iyo 64) ayaa Barcelona u keenay guusha Champions League-ka. Natiijooyinka kale ee habeenkaas oo uu xaqiijiyay bogga rasmiga ah ee UEFA waxaa ka mid ah Manchester United 3-2 Roma, Villarreal 0-6 Paris Saint-Germain iyo Atlético de Madrid 0-2 Bayern München.
news.imageAlt: Raphinha, ciyaaryahanka Barcelona, oo xiran funaanadda xulka Brazil

news.title: Zelensky oo rajeynaya in wadahadallada Abu Dhabi ay u horseedaan kulan uu la yeesho Putin
news.summary: Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky oo Berlin kula kulmay Jaanseler Friedrich Merz ayaa sheegay inuu rajeynayo in wadahadallada Abu Dhabi ee 10 iyo 11 November ay waddo u furaan kulan saddex geesood ah oo heer madaxeed ah. Ergayga gaarka ah ee Mareykanka Steve Witkoff ayaa ku dhawaaqay wadahadallada, halka Kremlin-ku sheegay in ergada Ruushka uu hoggaamin doono Vladimir Medinsky.
news.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky
news.imageCredit: President Of Ukraine from Україна / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Madasha Badbaadinta Qaranka oo aqbashay wada-hadal lala yeesho Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh
news.summary: Mucaaradka ayaa sheegay inay madaxweynaha siinayaan fursad kama dambays ah oo lagu xalliyo khilaafka doorashada iyo dastuurka, waxayna magacaabeen guddi 3 xubnood ah oo 14-ka bishan la kulmi doona guddiga farsamada ee dowladda. Waxaa la sheegay in aan weli la ogeyn in Puntland iyo Jubaland ay ka qayb geli doonaan.
news.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo khudbad ka jeedinaya Madasha Hoggaamiyeyaasha Qaranka, Muqdisho 2016

news.title: Ugu yaraan 73 qof oo ku dhaawacmay duqeyn Ruushku ku qaaday isbitaal ku yaal Kharkiv
news.summary: Madaxweyne Volodymyr Zelenskyy ayaa sheegay in Ruushku habeennimadii weerar ku qaaday isbitaal iyo xarumo koronto oo ku yaal gobollo badan oo Ukraine ah, isagoo adeegsaday 289 diyaaradood oo aan duuliye lahayn, 17 gantaal oo ballistic ah iyo 59 gantaal oo cruise ah. Wasaaradda Difaaca Ruushka ayaa sheegtay inay beegsatay xarumo koronto oo quudiya ciidamada iyo warshadaha milatariga ee Ukraine.
news.imageAlt: Dhismaha jaamacadda ee Fagaaraha Xorriyadda, magaalada Kharkiv
news.imageCredit: Adam Jones from Kelowna, BC, Canada / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Codbixinta doorashada xilli-dhexaadka Mareykanka oo bilaabatay
news.summary: Waxaa la sheegay in codbixintu ay go'aamin doonto dhammaan 435 kursi ee Aqalka Wakiilada, 35 ka mid ah 100 kursi ee Golaha Guurtida iyo xilka guddoomiyaha 36 gobol, iyadoo loo arkayo imtixaan u ah Madaxweyne Donald Trump. Waaxda Caddaaladda ayaa sheegtay inay geysay 1,000 kormeere oo doorasho dhammaan 50-ka gobol.
news.imageAlt: Calaamad tilmaamaysa goob codbixin oo ku taal Mareykanka
news.imageCredit: Tony Webster from Minneapolis, Minnesota, United States / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Jesús de Miguel, ciyaaryahanka Tenerife, oo geeriyooday kadib isku dhac garoonka dhexdiisa
news.summary: Kooxda Tenerife ayaa Talaadadii ku dhawaaqday geerida weeraryahankeeda 30 jirka ah, kaas oo dhaawac ka soo gaaray isku dhac uu la galay goolhayaha Andorra, Jesús Owono, ciyaartii La Liga 2 ee Isniintii. Ciyaarta oo 2-2 ahayd ayaa la joojiyay, Owono-na waxaa la tusay kaar casaan ah.
news.imageAlt: Garoonka Heliodoro Rodríguez López ee kooxda Tenerife, Santa Cruz de Tenerife

news.title: Ciidamada Uganda oo amniga Baraawe iyo Shalanbood u wareejiyay ciidanka xoogga dalka
news.summary: Waxaa la sheegay in wareejintan ay soo afjartay joogitaan milatari oo ka badan toban sano oo Uganda ku lahayd labada magaalo ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose. Afhayeenka ciidamada Uganda, Korneyl Chris Magezi, ayaa sheegay in dhammaan ciidamada Uganda ee Soomaaliya, kuwa AUSSOM ku jira oo ay ku jiraan, ay si tallaabo-tallaabo ah uga bixi doonaan dhammaadka 2027.
news.imageAlt: Askar Uganda ah oo ka tirsan AMISOM oo maraya magaalada Baraawe sannadkii 2014

news.title: Duufaanta Murasu oo ku dhufatay xeebta bari ee Hindiya
news.summary: Hay'adda Saadaasha Hawada Hindiya ayaa sheegtay in duufaantu ay dhulka ka soo gashay meel u dhow magaalada Ongole ee gobolka Andhra Pradesh, waana duufaantii labaad ee aagga ku dhufata toddobaad gudihiis. Mas'uuliyiinta ayaa sheegay in aan wax dhimasho ah weli la soo werin, iyadoo qorshuhu ahaa in ilaa 30,000 qof laga daad-gureeyo meelaha khatarta ah.
news.imageAlt: Muuqaal hawada laga qaaday oo ah magaalada Ongole ee gobolka Andhra Pradesh

news.title: India iyo Pakistan oo dalab tikidh ka badan kan finalka ku heshay Koobka Adduunka Cricket 2027
news.summary: Golaha Cricket-ka Adduunka (ICC) ayaa sheegay in ciyaarta labada dal ee 10 Oktoobar ka dhici doonta garoonka Wanderers ee Johannesburg ay heshay 8.4 milyan oo dalab tikidh, halka finalku helay ku dhawaad 8 milyan. Tartanka waxaa wada martigelin doona Koonfur Afrika, Zimbabwe iyo Namibia.
news.imageAlt: Garoonka cricket-ka ee Wanderers ee magaalada Johannesburg

news.title: FIFA oo xubnaha golaheeda tusi doonta dukumentiyada qorshihii iibinta saamiyada Koobka Adduunka
news.summary: Al Jazeera, oo soo xiganaysa warbaahinta Ingiriiska, ayaa werisay in 37-ka xubnood ee golaha FIFA ay dukumentiyada ku eegi karaan oo keliya ballan shaqsi ah oo Zurich ah, iyadoo xogta aan la siin doonin dadweynaha. Qorshaha $4.2bn ah ee Gianni Infantino ayaa la joojiyay bishii Luulyo kadib dhaleeceyn caalami ah, halka UEFA ay dalbatay faahfaahintiisa.
news.imageAlt: Xarunta FIFA ee magaalada Zurich, Switzerland

news.title: Luka Dončić oo 42 dhibcood dhaliyay, Lakers-na 138-117 kaga adkaatay Miami Heat
news.summary: Dončić ayaa sidoo kale bixiyay 13 caawin, waana markii afraad ee 5-tii ciyaarood ee u dambeeyay uu dhaliyo in ka badan 40 dhibcood. Guusha ayaa Lakers ka dhigtay 6-2 xilli ciyaareedkan, natiijadana waxaa sidoo kale werisay US News.
news.imageAlt: Luka Dončić oo xiran funaanadda Lakers lambarka 77

news.title: Laba helikobtar oo isku dhacay meel u dhow Everest, hal qof ayaa ku dhintay
news.summary: Mas'uuliyiinta Nepal ayaa sheegay in nin 47 jir ah oo u dhashay Hindiya uu ku dhintay, halka qof New Zealand u dhashay iyo duuliye Nepali ah ay dhaawacmeen. Shilka ayaa ka dhacay tuulada Pheriche oo ku taal joog qiyaastii 4,200 mitir, xilli labada diyaaradood ay isku dayayeen inay ka degaan meel ka hooseysa saldhigga Everest.
news.imageAlt: Tuulada Pheriche iyo dooxada Khumbu ee aagga Everest, Nepal

news.title: Maxkamadda Sare ee Australia oo dhageysatay dacwad ka dhan ah mamnuucidda baraha bulshada ee carruurta
news.summary: Shirkadda Reddit iyo kooxda Digital Freedom Project ayaa maxkamadda ka codsaday inay buriso sharciga u diidaya carruurta ka yar 16 sano inay isticmaalaan baraha bulshada, kaas oo dhaqan galay Diseembar sannadkii hore. Dowladda Australia ayaa sheegtay in xayiraaddu ay carruurta ka ilaalinayso waxyaabaha naxdinta leh iyo dadka ugaarsada carruurta ee internetka.
news.imageAlt: Dhismaha Maxkamadda Sare ee Australia ee magaalada Canberra

news.title: Koobka Aasiya 2027 ee Sacuudiga oo loo wareejiyay bisha Diseembar
news.summary: Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Aasiya (AFC) ayaa sheegay in tartanka 24-ka kooxood uu hadda dhici doono 23 Diseembar 2027 ilaa 21 Janaayo 2028, halkii uu ka furmi lahaa 7 Janaayo 2027, sababo la xiriira dhibaatooyin saadka iyo safarka ah oo ka dhashay xaaladda gobolka. Taariikhaha cusub waxaa loo gudbin doonaa FIFA si ay u ansixiso.
news.imageAlt: Garoonka Caalamiga ah ee King Fahd ee magaalada Riyadh

news.title: Weerar internet oo gaaray qaboojiyeyaasha suuqyada waaweyn ee dhowr dal oo Yurub ah
news.summary: Weerar internet ah oo lagu qaaday nidaamka xakameynta qaboojiyeyaasha ayaa saameeyay suuqyo waaweyn oo ku yaal Beljim, Iswiidhan, Finland, Ayrlaand iyo dalal kale, taasoo keentay in cunto badan la tuuro. Beljim ayaa furtay baaritaan dambi, mana jiro cid si rasmi ah loo sheegay inay ka dambeysay.
news.imageAlt: Qaboojiye caano oo ku jira suuq weyn (sawir muujinaya, Norway 2017)

news.title: Baarlamaanka Puntland oo kulan wadatashi ah kala yeeshay siyaasiyiin ku saabsan wax-ka-beddelka dastuurka
news.summary: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Wakiilada Puntland Cabdirisaaq Axmed Siciid ayaa furay kulan wadatashi oo uu yeeshay guddi gaar ah oo qiimeynaya wax-ka-beddelka la soo jeediyay ee dastuurka Puntland. Mas'uuliyiin hore oo Puntland iyo dowladda federaalka ka soo shaqeeyay ayaa ka qeyb galay oo soo bandhigay aragtiyadooda iyo talooyinkooda.
news.imageAlt: Cabdirisaaq Axmed Siciid, guddoomiyaha Golaha Wakiilada Puntland

news.title: NBA: Gilgeous-Alexander oo 43 dhibcood dhaliyay, Thunder-na 117-112 kaga adkaatay Cavaliers
news.summary: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander ayaa dhaliyay 43 dhibcood oo ah kiisii ugu badnaa xilli ciyaareedkan, isagoo Oklahoma City Thunder ka caawiyay guul ay ka gaartay Cleveland Cavaliers. Donovan Mitchell ayaa Cavaliers u dhaliyay 17 dhibcood iyo 11 caawin, sida ay GMA News iyo TSN wariyeen.
news.imageAlt: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander oo u ciyaaraya Oklahoma City Thunder (2022)

news.title: Everton oo 1-0 kaga adkaatay Newcastle garoonka St James' Park
news.summary: Thierno Barry ayaa dhaliyay goolka kaliya ee ciyaarta daqiiqadii 49-aad, halka Jacob Ramsey oo Newcastle ah laga saaray garoonka waqtiga dheeraadka ah kadib laba kaar oo jaalle ah. Natiijada waxaa xaqiijiyay ESPN iyo beIN SPORTS.
news.imageAlt: Garoonka St James' Park ee magaalada Newcastle

news.title: Jaamacadda Carabta oo cambaareysay safiirka Israa'iil ee Somaliland iyo safaaradda Hargeysa
news.summary: Xoghayaha Guud ee Jaamacadda Carabta, Naabiil Fahmi, ayaa sheegay in tallaabooyinkan aysan sharciyad lahayn oo ay xadgudub ku yihiin madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada Soomaaliya. Jaamacaddu waxay ku celisay inay diidan tahay xiriir kasta oo rasmi ah ama aan rasmi ahayn oo lala yeesho maamulka Somaliland.
news.imageAlt: Xarunta Jaamacadda Carabta ee magaalada Qaahira

news.title: Mareykanka oo Koonfur Afrika iyo Rwanda ka hakinaya ganacsiga canshuur la'aanta ah ee AGOA
news.summary: Ergayga Ganacsiga Mareykanka Jamieson Greer ayaa ku dhawaaqay in Koonfur Afrika iyo Rwanda laga hakinayo barnaamijka AGOA laga bilaabo 1 Janaayo 2027, isagoo sheegay in labada dal aysan buuxin shuruudaha. Koonfur Afrika ayaa sannadkii 2025 barnaamijkan ku dhoofisay alaab qiimaheedu yahay ku dhawaad $1.7 bilyan.
news.imageAlt: Sawirka rasmiga ah ee Ergayga Ganacsiga Mareykanka Jamieson Greer (2025)
news.imageCredit: Office of the United States Trade Representative / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Iiraan oo sheegtay in qorsheheeda xabbad-joojinta ee Mareykanka la dedejin karo
news.summary: Afhayeenka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Iiraan Esmaeil Baghaei ayaa sheegay in qorshaha xabbad-joojinta ee Iiraan u soo jeedisay Mareykanka hadda lagu fulin karo laba maalmood halkii toddoba, kaasoo ay ku jirto dib u furidda Marinka Hormuz. Iiraan ayaa ku adkaysatay in Mareykanku qaado xannibaadda badda iyo cunaqabateynta.
news.imageAlt: Abbas Araghchi, hadda wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Iiraan, oo booqasho ku jooga IAEA (2021)

news.title: Jarmalka: Ururka IG Metall oo bilaabay shaqo-joojinno mushaar kordhin ah
news.summary: Ururka shaqaalaha ee IG Metall ayaa bilaabay shaqo-joojinno ka dhacay shirkadaha sida Audi iyo Mercedes-Benz, isagoo dalbanaya kororka mushaarka 5% ee ku dhawaad 3.7 milyan oo shaqaale ah. Ururka ayaa diiday dalabka loo-shaqeeyayaasha oo uu ku tilmaamay mushaar dhimis dhab ah.
news.imageAlt: Shaqaale ka tirsan ururka IG Metall oo shaqo-joojin digniin ah ku sameynaya magaalada Witten ee Jarmalka (2012)

news.title: Hindiya oo sheegtay inay xorreysay markabka kalluumeysiga Azini oo laga afduubay xeebaha Bari
news.summary: Dowladda Hindiya ayaa sheegtay in ciidamadeeda badda iyo cirka ay hawlgal 48 saac ah oo Badweynta Hindiya ka dhacay ku xorreeyeen markabka kalluumeysiga Azini oo calanka Iiraan wata iyo 20 shaqaale ah oo saarnaa. Markabka ayaa la sheegay in la afduubay 29 Oktoobar inta u dhaxaysa Bandar Beyla iyo Xaafuun.
news.imageAlt: Markabka dagaalka ee ciidamada badda Hindiya INS Betwa oo ku xiran dekedda Mumbai (2009)

news.title: Ukraine: 24 qof oo ku dhintay duqeyn lagu qaaday xarun gargaar oo ku taal gobolka Zaporizhzhia
news.summary: Hay'adda gurmadka degdegga ah ee Ukraine ayaa sheegtay in 24 qof ay ku dhinteen duqeyn Ruushka lagu eedeeyay oo ku dhacday iskuul loo isticmaali jiray xarun gargaar oo ku yaal tuulada Komyshuvakha. Madaxweyne Zelenskyy ayaa cambaareeyay weerarka, halka Ruushka uu horay u beeniyay inuu bartilmaameedsado dadka rayidka ah.
news.imageAlt: Dhismaha iskuulka muusikada ee tuulada Komyshuvakha, gobolka Zaporizhzhia (2025)
Arday xiray albaabka dugsiga sare ee Buffon ee Paris, Desembar 2024
news.title: Faransiiska: dibadbaxyada ardayda dugsiyada sare oo dib u bilowday, balse si yar
news.summary: Ardayda dugsiyada sare ee Faransiiska ayaa dib u bilaabay dibadbaxyadii kadib fasax laba toddobaad ah, balse Wasaaradda Waxbarashadu waxay sheegtay in Isniintii 41 dugsi oo keliya la xiray, halkii toddobaadyadii hore boqollaal la xiri jiray.

news.imageAlt: Jasiiradda İmralı oo laga sawiray diyaarad
news.title: Abdullah Öcalan oo loo wareejiyay qayb cusub oo ka mid ah xabsiga jasiiradda İmralı
news.summary: Turkiga ayaa Abdullah Öcalan, aasaasihii xisbiga PKK ee xiran, u wareejiyay qayb cusub oo laga dhisay xabsiga jasiiradda İmralı, sida ay sheegeen xildhibaanno ka tirsan xisbiga DEM, ayuu yiri Al Jazeera.

news.imageAlt: Maxkamadda federaalka ee Brooklyn, New York
news.title: Maxkamad Brooklyn ku taal oo bilaabaysa dacwadda laba ciyaaryahan oo MLB ah oo lagu eedeeyay khamaar
news.summary: Emmanuel Clase iyo Luis Ortiz oo hore ugu ciyaari jiray Cleveland Guardians ayaa maxkamad federaal oo ku taal Brooklyn ka wajahaya dacwad ay xeer-ilaaliyayaashu ku eedeeyeen inay lacag ka qaateen laba khamaarle, waxayna labaduba ku doodeen inaysan dambi gelin, iyadoo la soo xiganayo AP.

news.imageAlt: Garoonka Santiago Bernabéu ee kooxda Real Madrid
news.title: Telefishinka dowladda Shiinaha oo sii wada joojinta ciyaaraha Real Madrid kadib muranka Mbappé
news.summary: Labada kanaal ee isboortiga CCTV ma aysan baahin guushii 3-0 ee Real Madrid ay Axaddii ka gaartay Racing Santander, iyadoo muranka ka dhashay muuqaal Kylian Mbappé uu ku hadlay Mao Zedong uu weli socdo, iyadoo la soo xiganayo AFP.

news.imageAlt: Haween ka shaqeeya warshad dhar oo ku taal Bangladesh
news.imageCredit: Tareq Salahuddin from Dhaka, Bangladesh / Wikimedia Commons
news.title: Bangladesh: dibadbaxyada shaqaalaha warshadaha dharka oo maalintii saddexaad socda
news.summary: Boqollaal warshadood oo dhar ah oo Bangladesh ku yaal ayaa hawshoodu carqaladowday iyadoo shaqaaluhu ay ka dibadbaxayaan mushahar yar iyo qaali noqoshada nolosha.

news.imageAlt: Magaalada qadiimiga ah ee Hebron
news.title: Guddoomiyaha Hebron oo sheegay in ciidamada Israa'iil ka baxeen magaalada kadib 10 maalmood oo go'doomin ah
news.summary: Guddoomiyaha Hebron Khaled Dudin ayaa Isniintii sheegay in ciidamada Israa'iil ay ka baxeen magaalada ku taal Daanta Galbeed kadib go'doomin socotay 10 maalmood, ciidamada amniga Falastiinna ayaa la wareegay deegaanka.

news.imageAlt: Yaxel Lendeborg oo u ciyaaraya Michigan, Febraayo 2026
news.title: NBA: Yaxel Lendeborg oo 37 dhibcood dhaliyay, Warriors-na 124-112 kaga adkaatay Clippers
news.summary: Ciyaaryahanka sannadkiisa koowaad ee Golden State Warriors Yaxel Lendeborg ayaa dhaliyay 37 dhibcood, waana tirada ugu badan ee ciyaaryahan cusub oo Warriors ah dhaliyo tan iyo Stephen Curry 2010.

news.imageAlt: Muuqaal guud oo magaalada Boosaaso ah
news.title: Puntland oo diiwaangelinaysa ciidamo ay Mareykanku ku tababarayaan saldhig ku yaal Boosaaso
news.summary: Maamulka Puntland ayaa bilaabay diiwaangelinta ku dhawaad 100 askari oo ka kala socda cutubyo amni oo kala duwan, kuwaas oo Mareykanku ku tababari doono saldhig ciidan oo ku yaal Boosaaso, iyadoo la soo xiganayo warbaahinta maxalliga ah.
news.lengthNote: Garowe Online oo kaliya ayaa warka bixisay, sarkaal lama xigan, faahfaahinta heshiiska lama shaacin; xog kale oo la xaqiijin karo lama helin.

news.title: Kimi Antonelli oo noqday horyaalka adduunka ee ugu da’da yar taariikhda Formula 1
news.summary: Darawalka Mercedes Kimi Antonelli oo 20 jir ah ayaa kaalinta 3-aad ka galay Mexico City Grand Prix, wuxuuna ku guuleystay horyaalnimada darawallada, halka Max Verstappen uu ku guuleystay tartanka, sida ay FIA sheegtay.
news.imageAlt: Kimi Antonelli oo dabaaldegaya kadib tartankii China Grand Prix (2026)

news.title: Serie A: Juventus oo 2-0 garaacday Napoli, Lazio oo kaalinta koowaad qabsatay
news.summary: Juventus ayaa 2-0 kaga adkaatay Napoli oo 10 ciyaartoy ku dhammeysatay, halka Lazio oo 2-1 garaacday Cagliari ay markii ugu horreysay 16 sano kadib hoggaanka Serie A qabsatay.
news.imageAlt: Garoonka Juventus (Allianz Stadium) ee magaalada Turin, Talyaaniga

news.title: Baarlamaanka Carabta oo cambaareeyay weerarkii markabka gaaska ee Qatar
news.summary: Baarlamaanka Carabta ayaa si adag u cambaareeyay bartilmaameedsiga markabka gaaska dareeraha ah (LNG) ee Al Mayeda ee Qatar, intii uu marayay Gacanka Carabta, wuxuuna ka digay in weerarradaas ay khatar ku yihiin amniga gobolka iyo sahayda tamarta.
news.imageAlt: Markabka gaaska dareeraha ah ee Mozah oo ay leedahay shirkadda Qatar ee Nakilat, dekedda Ras Laffan (2010)

news.title: Isbitaalka Erdogan ee Muqdisho oo keenay qalab casri ah oo lagu ogaado kansarka
news.summary: Isbitaalka Recep Tayyip Erdogan (Digfeer) ee Muqdisho ayaa qaybtiisa baaritaanka unugyada ku daray saddex mashiin oo markii ugu horreysay la keenay Soomaaliya, sida uu Dawan Africa u sheegay madaxa qaybta, Dr. Ismaaciil Maxamuud Cabdullaahi.
news.imageAlt: Xarunta Isbitaalka Recep Tayyip Erdogan ee Muqdisho (2015)

news.title: Premier League: Arsenal oo 1-0 kaga adkaatay Liverpool, hoggaankana qabsatay
news.summary: Gool uu Kai Havertz dhaliyay daqiiqadii 16-aad ayaa Arsenal u horseeday guushii ugu horreysay ee ay Anfield ka gaarto 14 sano gudahood, waxayna u gudubtay kaalinta koowaad ee Premier League.
news.imageAlt: Garoonka Anfield ee kooxda Liverpool oo laga muuqaal qaaday safka weyn

news.title: Bundesliga: Eintracht Frankfurt oo 3-1 kaga adkaatay Hamburger SV
news.summary: Eintracht Frankfurt ayaa 3-1 ku garaacday Hamburger SV, waxayna u dalacday kaalinta 8-aad ee Bundesliga, sida ay Bulinews iyo IANS ku warrameen.
news.imageAlt: Ciyaar Eintracht Frankfurt ku dhex martay garoonkeeda Waldstadion (Deutsche Bank Park), 2024

news.title: LaLiga: Real Madrid oo 3-0 kaga adkaatay Racing Santander
news.summary: Real Madrid ayaa qeybtii hore saddex gool ku dhalisay garoonka Racing Santander, waxayna gaartay guushii lixaad oo isku xigta, sida ay muujiyeen warbixinnada kooxda iyo ESPN.
news.imageAlt: Garoonka El Sardinero ee magaalada Santander, Isbaanish

news.title: SomBank iyo IBS Bank oo maalgelin Islaami ah u fidiyay kalluumeysatada Soomaaliyeed
news.summary: SomBank ayaa sheegtay inay kalluumeysatada Soomaaliyeed siisay maalgelin Islaami ah oo gaareysa ilaa $2 milyan, halka IBS Bank ay soo bandhigtay adeeg cusub oo lagu magacaabo “Kalluun Kaabe”.
news.imageAlt: Laba kalluumeysato Soomaaliyeed oo ku sugan magaalada Baraawe

news.title: Barnaamijka Saudi Noor oo Muqdisho ka bilaabay daaweyn iyo qalliin bilaash ah oo indhaha
news.summary: Barnaamijka bani’aadminnimo ee Saudi Noor 2026 ayaa Isbitaalka Madiina ee Muqdisho ka bilaabay adeegyo bilaash ah oo daryeelka indhaha, kuwaas oo lagu wado inay gaaraan ku dhawaad 500 bukaan.
news.imageAlt: Dhakhtar ku jira qaybta gurmadka ee Isbitaalka Madiina, Muqdisho (2014)
news.imageCredit: Tobin Jones / AU UN IST / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Ligue 1: Marseille oo 2-0 kaga adkaatay Toulouse garoonka Vélodrome
news.summary: Olympique de Marseille ayaa 2-0 ku garaacday Toulouse ciyaar ka tirsan wareegga 9-aad ee Ligue 1.
news.imageAlt: Garoonka Vélodrome ee kooxda Olympique de Marseille

news.title: Shirka COP17 oo Yerevan ku ansixiyay qorshe lagu dardargelinayo ilaalinta dabeecadda
news.summary: Dalalka ka qeybgalay Shirka QM ee Kala-duwanaanshaha Noolaha (COP17) ee caasimadda Armenia ayaa ku heshiiyay “Yerevan Pathway”, oo ah qorshe lagu dardargelinayo 23-ka hadaf ee la doonayo in la gaaro 2030.
news.imageAlt: Albaabka xarunta Shirka QM ee Kala-duwanaanshaha Noolaha (COP17) ee Yerevan, Armenia

news.title: Mo Ibrahim: Dimuqraadiyadda iyo xuquuqda aadanaha Afrika waa hoos u dhacayaan
news.summary: Mo Ibrahim, aasaasaha hay’adda Mo Ibrahim Foundation, ayaa wakaaladda AFP u sheegay in dimuqraadiyadda iyo xuquuqda aadanaha ay Afrika hoos ugu dhacayaan. Tusmada hay’addu waxay muujisay horumar dhaqaale, balse hoos u dhac xagga amniga iyo ka qeybgalka dadweynaha.
news.imageAlt: Mo Ibrahim oo khudbad ka jeedinaya shir ka dhacay Uppsala, Iswiidhan (2014)

news.title: Madaxweyne Cirro oo Hargeysa ku guddoomay warqadaha aqoonsiga safiirka Israa’iil
news.summary: Madaxweynaha Somaliland Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro) ayaa Axaddii qasriga madaxtooyada ee Hargeysa ku guddoomay warqadaha aqoonsiga Michael Lotem, oo ah safiirka Israa’iil u fadhiya Somaliland.
news.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Cirro oo Hargeysa kula hadlaya taliyaha AFRICOM, Gen. Dagvin Anderson (Nofeembar 2025)
news.imageCredit: Sgt. 1st Class Kenneth Tucceri, U.S. Army / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Hawlgalkii QM ee Saxaraha Galbeed (MINURSO) oo dhammaaday kadib 35 sano
news.summary: Muddada hawlgalka MINURSO ayaa dhammaatay saqdii dhexe ee Sabtida kadib markii Golaha Ammaanka uu ku heshiin waayay mustaqbalkiisa. Xoghayaha Guud António Guterres ayaa sheegay in QM ay diyaar u tahay inay sii taageerto dadaallada nabadda.
news.imageAlt: Xarunta hawlgalka MINURSO ee magaalada Laayoune (2012)

news.title: Boosaaso oo lagu qabtay tartankii ugu horreeyay ee kubadda cagta xeebta Soomaaliya
news.summary: Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Puntland iyo Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Soomaaliya ayaa 30 Oktoobar Boosaaso ka furay tartan kubadda cagta xeebta ah oo ay ka qayb galayaan 6 kooxood, kaas oo markii ugu horreysay ay haweenku ka muuqdaan.
news.imageAlt: Magaalada Boosaaso iyo xeebteeda oo hawada laga sawiray (2024)

news.title: Soomaaliya oo ka qayb gashay furitaanka Ciyaaraha Olombikada Dhallinyarada ee Dakar 2026
news.summary: Calanka Soomaaliya ayaa ka mid ahaa kuwa lagu soo bandhigay furitaanka Ciyaaraha Olombikada Dhallinyarada ee Dakar 2026, oo socon doona 31 Oktoobar ilaa 13 Nofembar. Soomaaliya waxaa matalaya feeryahanka 17 jirka ah Xasan Anwar oo ku tartamaya miisaanka 50 kiilo.
news.imageAlt: Damaashaadka toosha Ciyaaraha Olombikada Dhallinyarada Dakar 2026 ee Diamniadio

news.title: Golden State Valkyries oo ku guuleystay horyaalkii ugu horreeyay ee WNBA
news.summary: Golden State Valkyries ayaa ciyaartii 7aad ee finalka WNBA ku garaacday Atlanta Dream 68-63, waxayna qaadeen horyaalkoodii ugu horreeyay, iyagoo ku jira xilli-ciyaareedkoodii 2aad oo keliya.
news.imageAlt: Golden State Valkyries oo la ciyaaraya Indiana Fever (May 2026)

news.title: Lewis Hamilton oo ka bilaabaya safka hore Mexico City Grand Prix
news.summary: Lewis Hamilton ayaa markii ugu horreysay isagoo u tartamaya Ferrari ku guuleystay booska koowaad ee bilowga (pole) ee Mexico City Grand Prix, isagoo ka horreeyay George Russell iyo Charles Leclerc.
news.imageAlt: Lewis Hamilton oo baabuurka Ferrari wata (2025)

news.title: Canelo Álvarez oo dib u qaatay suunka WBC ee miisaanka super-middleweight
news.summary: Feeryahanka reer Mexico Canelo Álvarez ayaa magaalada Riyadh go’aan ay garsoorayaasha oo dhammi isku raaceen kaga adkaaday Christian Mbilli, oo ahaa horyaal aan weli laga badin, wuxuuna dib ula noqday suunka WBC.
news.imageAlt: Canelo Álvarez oo feeraha ku jira (sawir hore, 2017)

news.title: Nigeria oo baaraysa laba kiis oo looga shakiyay Ebola
news.summary: Xarunta Nigeria ee La-dagaallanka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada (NCDC) ayaa sheegtay in waqooyi-bari dalka laga helay laba qof oo looga shakiyay Ebola; waa la go’doomiyay, baaritaan shaybaarna waa lagu wadaa.
news.imageAlt: Fayraska Ebola oo mikroskoob lagu sawiray

news.title: Midowga Yurub oo baaraya warar sheegaya in markab kalluumeysi oo Iiraan leedahay lagu afduubay xeebaha Bari
news.summary: Hawlgalka badda ee Midowga Yurub, ATALANTA, ayaa baaraya warar sheegaya in burcad-badeed ay 29 Oktoobar afduubeen markabka kalluumeysiga Azini ee Iiraan leedahay, meel u dhow degmada Bandarbeyla. Xarunta Amniga Badda ee MSCIO ayaa maraakiibta ganacsiga ugu baaqday inay feejignaan muujiyaan.
news.imageAlt: Astaanta Midowga Yurub oo ku taal markab dagaal oo ka qayb qaata hawlgalka Atalanta (sawir hore, 2009)

news.title: Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed oo Baydhabo ku guddoomiyay shir amni oo aan caadi ahayn
news.summary: Wakaaladda wararka dowladda, SONNA, ayaa sheegtay in hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed, Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe), uu Baydhabo ku guddoomiyay shir lagu qiimeeyay xaaladda amni ee deegaannada maamulka. Shirka waxaa looga hadlay xoojinta tallaabooyinka amniga iyo iskaashiga hay'adaha ammaanka.
news.imageAlt: Sheikh Adan Mohamed Nur, sawir hore

news.title: Soomaaliya iyo Cumaan oo ka wada hadlay ballaarinta ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga
news.summary: Wasiirka Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha, Jamaal Maxamed Xasan, ayaa Muqdisho kula kulmay safiirka Cumaan u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Saalim bin Xabiib Al Camiri. Waxaa la sheegay in kulanku diiradda saaray xoojinta ganacsiga labada dal iyo abuurista fursado cusub oo ganacsi.
news.imageAlt: Qasriga Al Alam ee magaalada Muscat, Cumaan

news.title: Soomaaliya iyo Ruushka oo ka wada hadlay iskaashiga amniga iyo tababarka booliska
news.summary: Wasiirka Amniga Gudaha, Cabdullaahi Sheekh Ismaaciil (Fartaag), ayaa la kulmay Igor Zubov, ku-xigeenka Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha Ruushka. Zubov ayaa sheegay in dowladdiisu diyaar u tahay inay la wadaagto aqoonta iyo tababarka la dagaallanka dambiyada.
news.imageAlt: Saraakiil booliska Soomaaliyeed oo tababar ku jira, Akadeemiyada Booliska Generaal Kaahiye, Muqdisho (sawir hore, 2014)

news.title: Dowladda federaalka oo bilowday qorshaynta waddo 110 km ah oo isku xirta Buuhoodle iyo Tuulo-Samakaab
news.summary: Waxaa la sheegay in Wasiir Ayuub Ismaaciil oo ka tirsan dowladda federaalka uu saxiixay qorshaha waddada, iyadoo uu goobta joogay Xildhibaan Cabdi Qawdhan. Xildhibaanku wuxuu sheegay in mashruucu yahay guul weyn oo nolosha dadka deegaanka beddeli doona.
news.imageAlt: Magaalada Buuhoodle (sawir hore, 2015)

news.title: Barcelona oo 6-1 ku jabisay Alavés, Lamine Yamal-na 2 gool dhaliyay
news.summary: Barcelona ayaa 6-1 kaga adkaatay Alavés garoonka Spotify Camp Nou, waxayna dib ugu laabatay hoggaanka La Liga.
news.imageAlt: Lamine Yamal oo garoonka ku jira (2025)

news.title: Bayern iyo Dortmund oo 2-2 ku kala baxay, Harry Kane-na rigoore ayuu khasaariyay
news.summary: Bayern Munich iyo Borussia Dortmund ayaa garoonka Allianz Arena 2-2 ku kala baxay ciyaarta Der Klassiker ee Bundesliga.
news.imageAlt: Garoonka Allianz Arena ee Bayern Munich (sawir hore)

news.title: AC Milan oo 3-1 kaga adkaatay Inter ciyaarta derby-ga Milan
news.summary: AC Milan ayaa garoonka San Siro 3-1 kaga guuleysatay Inter, waxayna joojisay taxanaha Inter ee 9 ciyaarood oo horyaal ah oo aan laga badin.
news.imageAlt: Garoonka San Siro ee magaalada Milan (sawir hore)

news.title: Washington DC iyo Virginia oo dacwad ka gudbiyay qorshaha qaansada guusha ee Trump
news.summary: Washington DC iyo gobolka Virginia ayaa maxkamad federaal ah ka codsaday inay joojiso qorshaha Madaxweyne Trump ee ah in qaanso guul (triumphal arch) laga dhiso Memorial Circle, iyagoo ku tilmaamay mid sharci-darro ah.
news.imageAlt: Buundada Arlington Memorial iyo wabiga Potomac ee Washington, D.C.

news.title: Erdoğan oo ugu baaqay Ruushka iyo Ukraine inay joojiyaan weerarrada Badda Madow
news.summary: Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ayaa magaalada Istanbul, isagoo la taagan Madaxweyne Volodymyr Zelenskyy, ku sheegay in weerarrada lagu qaado maraakiibta rayidka ee Badda Madow aan la aqbali karin, cid kasta oo fulisaba.
news.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Recep Tayyip Erdoğan (2025)
news.imageCredit: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Netherlands) / Phil Nijhuis / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Guddiga Doorashooyinka oo furay diiwaangelinta ururrada siyaasadda ka hor doorashooyinka 2027
news.summary: Diiwaangelinta ururrada siyaasadda ayaa socon doonta 1 ilaa 22 Nofembar. Soomaaliya waxay isu diyaarinaysaa doorashada baarlamaanka ee Abriil 2027 iyo doorashada madaxtooyada ee Maajo 2027.
news.imageAlt: Astaanta Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka

news.title: Madaxweyne Deni oo diiday jadwalka doorashada 2027, kuna baaqay gole ku-meel-gaar ah
news.summary: Madaxweynaha Puntland, Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni, ayaa wareysi uu siiyay telefishinka Puntland ku sheegay inuusan arkin doorasho uu Xasan Sheekh qaban karo, wuxuuna ku baaqay gole ku-meel-gaar ah oo dalka u horseeda doorasho. Waxaa la xusay in eedeymaha uu soo jeediyay aan si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin.
news.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Puntland Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni oo ka hadlaya Golaha Wadatashiga Qaranka ee Muqdisho (2021)

news.title: Brighton oo 1-0 kaga adkaatay Manchester City garoonkeeda
news.summary: Yasin Ayari ayaa daqiiqaddii 11aad dhaliyay goolka keliya ee ciyaarta, Brighton-na markii ugu horreysay ayay garoonka City kaga guuleysatay, iyagoo isku dayay 18 jeer.
news.imageAlt: Garoonka Amex ee kooxda Brighton, Ingiriiska (2013)

news.title: Koonfur Afrika oo 176 orod kaga adkaatay Australia, taxanaha Test-kana ku guuleysatay
news.summary: Koonfur Afrika ayaa garoonka Newlands ku guuleysatay Test-kii 3aad, taxanahana 2-1 ku qaadatay, kadib markii Australia, oo looga baahnaa 288 orod, lagu wada saaray 111 orod.
news.imageAlt: Garoonka kirikitka ee Newlands, Cape Town

news.title: Chelsea oo 2-0 ku garaacday Manchester United, United-na 9 ciyaarood kuma guuleysan
news.summary: Chelsea ayaa garoonka Stamford Bridge 2-0 kaga adkaatay Manchester United, kadib markii Lisandro Martínez laga saaray kaarka cas daqiiqaddii 63aad.
news.imageAlt: Garoonka Stamford Bridge ee Chelsea, London, oo hawada laga sawiray (2023)

news.title: Somaliland oo ka digtay xadgudubyada loo geysto dadka Itoobiyaanka ah ee ku nool Boorama
news.summary: Wasiirka Warfaafinta Somaliland, Barkhad Jaamac Batuun, ayaa sheegay in aan loo dulqaadan doonin xadgudub ama cabsi gelin lagula kaco ajaanibta. Wuxuu sheegay in qofna aanu xaq u lahayn inuu si xoog ah u saaro ama u weeraro ajnabi, arrimahaasna ay mari doonaan habka sharciga.
news.imageAlt: Magaalada Boorama oo hawada laga sawiray (2024)

news.title: Ilaalada Xeebaha Mareykanka oo Soomaaliya ku dartay liiska dekedaha aan buuxin heerarka amniga
news.summary: Ilaalada Xeebaha Mareykanka ayaa ogeysiis ay soo saartay ku sheegtay in dekedaha Soomaaliya aysan haysan tallaabooyin wax ku ool ah oo looga hortago argagixisada. Go'aanka oo dhaqan galay 27 Oktoobar wuxuu keenayaa hubin amni oo dheeraad ah oo lagu sameeyo maraakiibta Mareykanka u socda kadib markay soo maraan dekedaha Soomaaliya.
news.imageAlt: Konteenarro ku jira dekedda Muqdisho (sawir hore, 2015)

news.title: Achraf Hakimi oo saddex gool dhaliyay, PSG-na 5-1 ku garaacday Le Havre
news.summary: PSG ayaa Jimcihii 5-1 kaga adkaatay Le Havre, daafaca reer Morocco Achraf Hakimi ayaa dhaliyay 3 gool, 2 kalena caawiyay.
news.imageAlt: Achraf Hakimi oo xiran funaanadda Morocco (2024)

news.title: Somaliland oo shacabka ka mamnuucday qaadashada hubka
news.summary: Taliyaha booliska Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Cabdullaahi, ayaa sheegay in ciidamada ammaanka la faray inay hubka ka qaadaan dadka aan haysan oggolaansho.
news.imageAlt: Magaalada Hargeysa oo hawada laga sawiray (2022)

news.title: Muqdisho oo lagu xusay sannad-guuradii 103-aad ee Jamhuuriyadda Turkiga
news.summary: Safaaradda Turkiga ee Muqdisho ayaa xaflad u qabatay sannad-guuradii 103-aad ee aasaaska Jamhuuriyadda Turkiga. Guddoomiyaha Aqalka Sare, Cabdi Xaashi Cabdullaahi, ayaa sheegay in xiriirka labada dal uu ku dhisan yahay saaxiibtinimo iyo is-ixtiraam, isagoo xusay booqashadii Erdoğan ee 2011.
news.imageAlt: Safaaradda Turkiga ee Muqdisho

news.title: Uganda oo bilowday ka bixitaanka ciidamadeeda Soomaaliya kadib ku dhowaad 20 sano
news.summary: Taliyaha ciidamada Uganda, Jen. Muhoozi Kainerugaba, ayaa sheegay in la bilaabay ka bixitaanka ciidamada UPDF ee Soomaaliya, amniganna loo wareejinayo ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. Waxaa la sheegay in tallaabadu ay timid xilli miisaaniyadda taageerada hawlgalka AUSSOM la dhimay.
news.imageAlt: Ciidamada Uganda ee hawlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya oo salaan sharaf bixinaya (sawir hore, 2021)

news.title: Machadka Heritage oo daabacay daraasad ku saabsan doorka bulshada rayidka ee Soomaaliya
news.summary: Machadka Heritage ee Daraasaadka Siyaasadda ayaa soo saaray daraasad lagu qiimeynayo doorka, waxtarka iyo caqabadaha ururrada bulshada rayidka ee Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan kaalintooda daah-furnaanta iyo la xisaabtanka dowladda. Agaasimaha machadka, Mursal Maxamuud Saney, ayaa sheegay in ururradaasi kaalin muhiim ah ka qaateen dowlad-dhiska.
news.imageAlt: Xubno ka tirsan ururrada bulshada rayidka ah oo ka qaybgalaya shir dadweyne oo Muqdisho ka dhacay (sawir hore, 2014)
Askarta Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo ka qeyb galaya dhoolatus ciidan (2013)
news.summary: Waxaa la sheegay in Jen. Barise, oo la magacaabay 25-kii Oktoobar, uu xilka kala wareegay Jen. Madey Nuuray Sheekh Ufurow. Barise ayaa horay xilkan u hayay 2019 ilaa 2020.
news.title: Jen. Maxamed Cali Barise oo si rasmi ah ula wareegay xilka Taliyaha Ciidamada Xoogga

news.imageAlt: Markabka qodista saliidda ee Turkiga Kanuni (2020), ma aha Çağrı Bey
news.summary: Guddoomiyaha Hay'adda Batroolka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegay in qodista ceelka Curad-1, oo ay wado shirkadda Turkiga ee TPAO, ay gaartay lakab ay ka muuqan karaan calaamadaha saliidda. Wuxuu sheegay in bartilmaameedka ugu dambeeya la filayo in la gaaro bisha Diseembar.
news.title: Hay'adda Batroolka: Ceelka saliidda ee badda Curad-1 wuxuu gaaray lakab muhiim ah

news.imageAlt: Xarunta Golaha Wakiilada ee Hargeysa (sawir hore, 2015)
news.summary: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha Somaliland ayaa soo saartay amar ay ku sheegtay in qof kasta oo ka qaybgala hawlaha siyaasadda Soomaaliya uu wajihi karo tallaabo sharci. Amarka lama caddeyn hawlaha uu khuseeyo iyo sida loo fulin doono.
news.title: Somaliland oo dadkeeda ka mamnuucday ka qaybgalka siyaasadda Soomaaliya

news.imageAlt: Shir Golaha Ammaanka QM uga socda xaaladda Soomaaliya (sawir hore, 2019)
news.summary: Hawlgalka siyaasadeed ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa Sabtida soo afjarmaya iyadoo aan la isku raacin hab beddela oo dhexdhexaadiya muranka muddo-xileedka madaxweynaha. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa mucaaradka ku casuumay wadahadal 14-18 Noofembar, balse kooxaha mucaaradka ee waaweyn weli ma xaqiijin ka-qaybgalkooda.
news.title: Hawlgalka QM oo dhammaanaya iyadoo aan la helin hab lagu xalliyo khilaafka doorashada

news.imageAlt: Khariidadda Soomaaliya oo muujinaysa dowlad goboleedka Hirshabeelle
news.summary: Waxaa la sheegay in golaha wasiirada Hirshabeelle, oo uu shir-guddoominayay Madaxweyne Guudlaawe, ay ansixiyeen miisaaniyadda 2027, taas oo 7% ka badan tii 2026. Shirka ayaa sidoo kale looga hadlay amniga, doorashooyinka iyo u diyaargarowga fatahaadaha.
news.title: Hirshabeelle oo ansixisay miisaaniyad $47.45 milyan ah oo sannadka 2027

news.imageAlt: Xildhibaanno federaal ah oo fadhiya xaflad baarlamaan (2016)
news.summary: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur ayaa sheegay in fadhiyada la hakinayo laga bilaabo 31-ka Oktoobar. Wuxuu sheegay in nidaamka cusub uu dhaqan-galin doono codbixin elektaroonig ah iyo diiwaangelin dijitaal ah.
news.title: Golaha Shacabka oo laba toddobaad hakiyay fadhiyada si loo rakibo nidaamka E-Parliament
Soomaaliya oo isu diyaarinaysa fatahaado El Niño oo laga cabsi qabo inay cunto-yaraanta kordhiyaan
news.summary: Barnaamijka Cuntada Adduunka (WFP) iyo hay'adaha la shaqeeya ayaa xoojinaya qorshayaasha xaaladaha degdegga ah, oo ay ku jiraan digniin hore, waddooyin gaadiid iyo lacag caddaan ah, ka hor roobabka El Niño. Bulshooyinka webiyada u dhow ayaa lagu tilmaamay kuwa ugu khatarta badan.
news.imageAlt: Sawir dayax-gacmeed oo muujinaya fatahaad ku teedsan webiga Shabeelle
news.imageCredit: MODIS Land Rapid Response Team, NASA GSFC / Wikimedia Commons

news.title: Midowga Yurub: Badeecadaha Soomaaliya waxay suuqyadiisa ku geli karaan canshuur la'aan
news.summary: Ergada Midowga Yurub ee Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in Soomaaliya ay ka mid tahay 33 dal oo Afrikaan ah oo nidaamka 'Everything But Arms' u oggolaanayo inay badeecadahooda, hubka mooyee, canshuur la'aan u dhoofiyaan Yurub. Waxaa la xusay in faa'iidadu ay ku xiran tahay in ganacsatadu buuxiyaan heerarka tayada ee Yurub.
news.imageAlt: Dekedda Berbera, oo badeecooyin badan laga dhoofiyo (2023)

news.title: Turkiga oo sheegay inuu markab cilmi-baaris iyo kalluumeysi u soo dirayo xeebaha Soomaaliya
news.summary: Safiirka Turkiga u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Ferhat Alkan, ayaa xilli lagu xusayay Toddobaadka Kalluumeysiga Qaranka ee Muqdisho ku dhawaaqay in markab cilmi-baaris iyo kalluumeysi loo soo dirayo si loo xoojiyo xirfadda kalluumeysatada Soomaaliyeed. Magaca markabka iyo goorta uu imanayo lama shaacin.
news.imageAlt: Doonyaha kalluumeysatada iyo shabaagyo ku yaal xeebta Garacad
Diyaarad dagaal oo nooca Su-35 ah
news.summary: Ra'iisul Wasaare Abiy Axmed ayaa ku dhawaaqay in Itoobiya ay heshay 12 diyaaradood oo nooca Su-35 ah, ayna sugayso nidaamyo difaaca hawada ah oo S-400 ah, xilli xiisad ka taagan tahay xadka Itoobiya iyo Eritrea.
news.title: Itoobiya oo sheegtay inay Ruushka ka heshay 12 diyaaradood oo dagaal

news.imageAlt: Tiir koronto oo ku yaal Muqdisho (sawir hore, 2015)
news.summary: Wasiir Cabdullaahi Bidhaan ayaa sheegay in kororka qiimaha korontada Muqdisho uu ka dhashay sicir-bararka shidaalka ee la xiriira xiisadda Bariga Dhexe, isagoo xusay in dowladdu ay hor istaagtay soo jeedin lagu labanlaabayay qiimaha.
news.title: Wasiirka Tamarta oo kor u kaca qiimaha korontada Muqdisho ku sababeeyay qiimaha shidaalka

news.imageAlt: Madaxweynihii hore Farmaajo oo khudbad jeedinaya (2017)
news.summary: Madaxweynihii hore Farmaajo ayaa dowladda ku eedeeyay inay ciidamada u isticmaalayso khilaafaadka siyaasadeed. Dowladda ayaa sheegtay in dagaalka lagu dilay 75 dagaalyahan oo Al-Shabaab ah.
news.title: Farmaajo oo baaritaan madax-bannaan ka dalbaday dagaalkii Jamea

news.imageAlt: Dhallinyaro ka qaybgalaya shir dhallinyarada oo Muqdisho ka dhacay (sawir hore, 2016)
news.summary: Qorshaha 2026–2030 ayaa loogu talagalay in kaalinta dhallinyarada ee dhismaha nabadda la kordhiyo.
news.title: Soomaaliya oo daah-furtay qorshe shan sano ah oo ku saabsan dhallinyarada, nabadda iyo amniga

news.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo shir ku jira (2015)
news.summary: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya ayaa dib u dhigay safarkii loo qorsheeyay Ruushka. Warbixinta ayaa go'aankan la xiriirisay weerarrada Al-Shabaab iyo xiisadda doorashooyinka.
news.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo dib u dhigay safar uu ku tagi lahaa Ruushka

news.imageAlt: Askar ku sugan agagaarka Buurhakabo oo qorrax-dhac lagu sawiray (sawir hore, 2013)
news.title: Shacabka ayaa gacanta u galay hubkii saarnaa gaariga la duqeeyay duleedka Buurhakabo

news.imageAlt: Ciidamada Midowga Afrika oo garoonka Muqdisho ku sugaya diyaarad (2011)
news.summary: Ka bixitaanka ciidamada ayaa walaac ka dhex abuuray xaaladda amniga Soomaaliya.
news.title: Ciidamada Midowga Afrika oo isu diyaarinaya inay ka baxaan saldhigyo muhiim ah

news.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Museveni oo soo dhaweynaya Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh, shirkii Kampala (2023)
news.summary: Madaxweynaha Uganda ayaa sheegay in midnimadu tahay furaha looga adkaan karo caqabadda ugu weyn ee Soomaaliya haysata.
news.title: Museveni oo Soomaalida ugu baaqay midnimo si looga adkaado Al-Shabaab

news.imageAlt: Nicholas Kay, madaxii ugu horreeyay ee UNSOM, oo Muqdisho yimid markii hawlgalka la aasaasay (2013)
news.summary: Xiritaanka hawlgalka ayaa soo afjaraya in ka badan soddon sano oo taageero QM ah oo ku aaddan dhismaha nabadda iyo maamulka.
news.title: Hawlgalkii siyaasadeed ee Qaramada Midoobay oo Soomaaliya ku dhammaaday

news.imageAlt: Shan nin oo xubno ka ah Madasha oo sawir wadajir ah ka qaaday
news.summary: Madasha Mucaaradka, oo ay ku jiraan Deni iyo Axmed Madoobe, iyo xisbiga Nabad iyo Nolol ayaa loo fidiyay wadatashiga, oo dhici doona 14–18 November.
news.title: Villa Soomaaliya oo si rasmi ah gogol wadatashi ugu fidisay Madasha Mucaaradka
